g_i_adrnaline005.name: Hyper-adrenal Alacrity
g_i_adrnaline005.description: Attribute Bonus: Dexterity +6 Speed: Movement +30% Duration: 120 secs  This model of alacrity stim uses a very powerful mixture of chemicals to produce an incredible increase in the dexterity of the user. Stim bonuses that affect the same statistic do not stack.

g_i_adrnaline006.name: Hyper-adrenal Stamina
g_i_adrnaline006.description: Attribute Bonus: Constitution +6 Duration: 120 secs  Steeling the user against pain, this stim provides a very large boost in constitution. Stim bonuses that affect the same statistic do not stack.

g_i_adrnaline004.name: Hyper-adrenal Strength
g_i_adrnaline004.description: Attribute Bonus: Strength +6 Duration: 120 secs  More effective than the basic model, this stim uses a risky cocktail of chemicals to boost the strength of the user. Stim bonuses that affect the same statistic do not stack.

dan_map2.description: This is a map to the area a bit south the Jedi Enclave on Dantooine.

holocron.name: Holocron
holocron.description: This holocron has been cracked and worn by the sands and wind, but is still marginally operational. When activated, it shows the holographic image of a middle-aged human man and appears to have been used as a means to record his personal thoughts over many years.

g_head.name: Mandalorian Head
g_head.description: This is the head of the leader of the Mandalorian warriors who were killing the Rakatan scouts.

g_i_pazdeck.name: Pazaak Deck
g_i_pazdeck.description: This is a standard Pazaak deck, complete with side deck cards.

g_shipparts.name: Ship Parts
g_shipparts.description: These ship parts appear to be similar enough to those on the Ebon Hawk that they could be used to repair it.

man28_sonic.name: Sonic Emitter
man28_sonic.description: This device emits a powerful sonic pulse useful for scaring off or stunning various wildlife. It normally has an extremely limited range, but in an underwater environment the signal would travel quite a distance. It has proven quite lethal to several species of firaxan sharks.

g_a_class4004.name: Cinnagar Weave Armor
g_a_class4004.description: A complex organic weave protects this armored suit from extremes in temperature. Armor similar to it proved decisive in defending Cinnagar from the Sith under Naga Sadow.

g_a_class4001.name: Combat Suit
g_a_class4001.description: Even the most frugal of mercenaries know they need at least some protection from the rigors of combat, although suits of this type are recommended for light skirmishes only.

g_a_class4006.name: Darth Bandon's Fiber Armor
g_a_class4006.description: Special: Upgradeable, Armor  Despite the unfortunate fate of Darth Bandon, this light armor remains a desirable asset for any warrior. The silvery polish reflects a pride in craftsmanship rarely seen today.

g_a_class4007.name: Darth Bandon's Fiber Armor
g_a_class4007.description: Special: Upgradeable, Armor  Despite the unfortunate fate of Darth Bandon, this light armor remains a desirable asset for any warrior. The silvery polish reflects a pride in craftsmanship rarely seen today.

g_a_class4008.name: Darth Bandon's Fiber Armor
g_a_class4008.description: Special: Upgradeable, Armor  Despite the unfortunate fate of Darth Bandon, this light armor remains a desirable asset for any warrior. The silvery polish reflects a pride in craftsmanship rarely seen today.

g_a_class4009.name: Echani Fiber Armor
g_a_class4009.description: Special: Upgradeable, Armor  Many elite Echani duelists use armor of this type, though its adaptability has made it popular with professional soldiers and bounty hunters alike.

g_a_class4003.name: Echani Light Armor
g_a_class4003.description: Echani prefer elegant design to brute force. The Maktites learned this when their stores of thermal weapons were rendered ineffective by simple changes in the Echani light armor.

geno_armor.name: GenoHaradan Mesh Armor
geno_armor.description: This perfectly balanced armor provides maximum protection without hampering a Genoharadan agent's ability to stalk his prey in total secrecy.

g1_a_class5001.name: Light Exoskeleton
g1_a_class5001.stat_modifiers: Ability +1; Ability +1; Ability +2; Armor +2; Armor +1; Armor +1
g1_a_class5001.description: Special: Upgradeable, Armor  A relatively new type of power-assisted armor, this suit mimics the major muscle movements of the wearer with mechanical impulses, resulting in greater strength and faster reaction times.

g_a_class4005.name: Massassi Ceremonial Armor
g_a_class4005.description: Long-term domination by the Sith has erased the memory of the Massassi rituals for which this armor was designed, but it retains its effectiveness on the battlefield regardless.

g_a_class4002.name: Zabrak Combat Suit
g_a_class4002.description: A Zabrak improvement on the combat suit, this armor is good protection where speed and unrestricted movement are more important than bulky plating.

g1_a_class5002.name: Baragwin Shadow Armor
g1_a_class5002.description: Special: Upgradeable, Armor  A specialty of the Baragwin, this modifiable suit has advanced adaptive camouflage technology that, when combined with a stealth generator, allows it to blend in nearly seamlessly with the background when viewed from any direction. It is generally only sold to respected governments, but a number have found their way into more disreputable distribution channels.

g_a_class5002.name: Bonadan Alloy Heavy Suit
g_a_class5002.description: Bonadan is an emerging industrial society financing their exploration of the galaxy through production of small arms and armor. They favor heavy materials offering solid defense.

g_a_class5007.name: Eriadu Prototype Armor
g_a_class5007.description: Special: Upgradeable, Armor  This armor combines good protection and easy movement to allow even a novice to fight like a seasoned veteran, but Eriadu has delayed general production pending further tests.

g_a_class5008.name: Eriadu Prototype Armor
g_a_class5008.description: Special: Upgradeable, Armor  This armor combines good protection and easy movement to create an impression of competence about the owner, but Eriadu has delayed general production pending further tests.

g_a_class5009.name: Eriadu Prototype Armor
g_a_class5009.description: Special: Upgradeable, Armor  This armor combines good protection and easy movement to allow even a novice to fight like a seasoned veteran, but Eriadu has delayed general production pending further tests.

g_a_class5001.name: Heavy Combat Suit
g_a_class5001.description: This version of the combat suit offers more protection than the basic model. It is heavier overall and not quite as flexible, but many consider the tradeoffs worthwhile.

g_a_class5005.name: Reinforced Fiber Armor
g_a_class5005.description: Inspired by craftsmen on worlds where metal is in short supply, this type of light armor consists of jung-ju tree fibers bound with synthetics, offering good, flexible protection.

g_a_class5010.name: Republic Mod Armor
g_a_class5010.description: Special: Upgradeable, Armor  The Republic has prospered militarily by keeping its troops well supplied with modular armor, ensuring they are always prepared for a variety of battle conditions.

g_a_class5006.name: Ulic Qel Droma's Mesh Suit
g_a_class5006.description: After killing his brother during the Exar Kun war, Ulic Qel Droma abandoned this armor and all the trappings of his service to the dark side. It's a powerful, if tainted, item.

g_a_class5003.name: Zabrak Battle Armor
g_a_class5003.description: In northern Iridonia the Zabrak produce expensive armor that nonetheless has become very popular on the galactic markets, due to excellent low-temperature defensive properties.

g_a_class5004.name: Zabrak Field Armor
g_a_class5004.description: This is a higher-quality version of the basic armor produced by the Zabrak. These were often reserved for field commanders, and meant to be easily identified on the battlefield.

g_a_class6005.name: Arkanian Bond Armor
g_a_class6005.description: Ancient Arkanians pioneered many unique alloys that lose heat at a very slow rate, producing armor that is very resistant to sudden changes in temperature.

g_a_class6003.name: Cinnagar War Suit
g_a_class6003.description: After the Great Hyperspace War a thousand years ago, the heirs of Empress Teta militarized their world and industry, a legacy that produced battle armor still sought after today.

g_a_class6007.name: Davik's War Suit
g_a_class6007.description: Davik spent lavishly on his safety, and many a bounty hunter ended up dead in the streets for underestimating both his will to live and the protective qualities of his armor.

g_a_class6008.name: Davik's War Suit
g_a_class6008.description: Special: Upgradeable, Armor  Davik spent lavishly on his safety, and many a bounty hunter ended up dead in the streets for underestimating both his will to live and the protective qualities of his armor.

g_a_class6009.name: Davik's War Suit
g_a_class6009.description: Special: Upgradeable, Armor  Davik spent lavishly on his safety, and many a bounty hunter ended up dead in the streets for underestimating both his will to live and the protective qualities of his armor.

g_a_class6002.name: Echani Battle Armor
g_a_class6002.description: This armor provides solid defense at the cost of some flexibility, although it is still an Echani product and is therefore well suited to quick-moving combat.

g1_a_class6001.name: Environmental Bastion Armor
g1_a_class6001.stat_modifiers: DamageImmunity +100; DamageImmunity +100; DamageImmunity +100; Armor +1; Armor +1; Armor +1; Immunity; Immunity
g1_a_class6001.description: Special: Upgradeable, Armor  A modified environmental suit, this armor gives the wearer complete protection from the elements as well as superior combat protection. With additional enhancements, it can be converted into a completely contained environmental system and shield the wearer from outside radiation as well.

g_a_class6006.name: Exar Kun's Light Battle Suit
g_a_class6006.description: Attributed to Exar Kun, this armor may well have been worn by the Dark Lord prior to his defeat forty years ago. He was rarely without considerable, yet flexible, personal armor.

g_a_class6001.name: Military Suit
g_a_class6001.description: This standard issue suit provides good protection, but can be heavier and more restrictive than some of its counterparts. Even so, many mercenaries swear the tradeoffs are worth it.

g_a_class6004.name: Verpine Fiber Mesh
g_a_class6004.description: Raxsus Nuli had plans of planetary conquest in the wake of Sith aggression. Though eclipsed by recent events, the Jedi saw the pirate jailed and his Verpine stockpiles auctioned.

g_a_class7002.name: Bronzium Light Battle Armor
g_a_class7002.description: This molded armor is made of better materials than standard military issue, but is still relatively cheap and easy to mass-produce, making it ideal for light militias and the like.

g1_a_class8001.name: Heavy Exoskeleton
g1_a_class8001.stat_modifiers: Ability +1; Ability +3; Ability +2; Ability +3; Armor +2; Armor +4
g1_a_class8001.description: Special: Upgradeable, Armor  A heavy and durable suit, this mechanical exoskeleton provides much greater strength and endurance, and vastly improved armor protection to the wearer than lighter models. With additional enhancements, this capability can be expanded even further, rivaling some light armored vehicles for protection.

g_a_class7006.name: Jamoh Hogra's Battle Armor
g_a_class7006.description: Jamoh Hogra was a Zabrak mercenary who feared for his life after a raid on a Sith dreadnaught. He spent a fortune on his personal armor, only to be killed while in the bath.

g_a_class7004.name: Krath Heavy Armor
g_a_class7004.description: Typical of the old Krath military elite, these suits were worn during slave raids on neighboring systems. Slaving is profitable but risky, so little cost is spared in equipment.

g_a_class7005.name: Krath Holy Battle Suit
g_a_class7005.description: Many Krath sought to be guards of their dark temples in armor of this type. Cynics dismiss this fervor, noting that guard duty was safer than participating in military slave raids.

g_a_class7001.name: Light Battle Armor
g_a_class7001.description: Providing solid protection for a minimal cost, this armor is excellent for entrenched troops or guards. A force on the move, however, may find it somewhat constricting.

g_a_class7003.name: Powered Light Battle Armor
g_a_class7003.description: This is an early attempt at power-assisted armor. Dampening fields block the noise of servomotors, unintentionally shielding against external extremes in sonic frequencies as well.

g_a_class8001.name: Battle Armor
g_a_class8001.description: This isn't the heaviest of armor, but it comes close. Designed for heavy militias, it has the protection needed to keep a soldier alive during ranged combat with massive weapons.

g_a_class8005.name: Calo Nord's Battle Armor
g_a_class8005.stat_modifiers: DamageResist; DamageResist; DamageResist; Armor +1; Armor +3; Immunity; Immunity; UseLimitationRacial
g_a_class8005.description: Special: Upgradeable, Armor  Commissioned by Calo Nord, this armor was based on heavily modified Mandalorian designs. The maker was killed to appease Nord's ego, ensuring his suit would forever be unique.

g_a_class8006.name: Calo Nord's Battle Armor
g_a_class8006.stat_modifiers: Armor +4; DamageResist; DamageResist; DamageResist; Immunity; UseLimitationRacial

g_a_class8007.description: Special: Upgradeable, Armor  Commissioned by Calo Nord, this armor was based on heavily modified Mandalorian designs. The maker was killed to appease Nord's ego, ensuring his suit would forever be unique.

g_a_class8003.name: Cinnagar Plate Armor
g_a_class8003.description: While much time was spent on the appearance, this armor is still meant for the personal guards of dignitaries, and is therefore highly effective against many forms of attack.

g_a_class8004.name: Mandalorian Armor
g_a_class8004.description: Mandalorians are among the most feared combatants in the galaxy, and the quality of their gear may be why. Even the lowliest warrior is a threat in such protective armor.

g_a_class8002.name: Powered Battle Armor
g_a_class8002.description: The micro-hydraulics of this armor provides the operator with both protection and strength enhancement. It is rare outside of professional mercenaries and soldiers.

g_a_class8009.name: Verpine Zal Alloy Mesh
g_a_class8009.description: Using the highly expensive Zal alloy, the Verpine have developed a suit without peer. The only thing greater than the protective capabilities of this armor is the price.

g_a_class9009.name: Cassus Fett's Battle Armor
g_a_class9009.stat_modifiers: Ability +1; DamageResist; DamageResist; DamageResist; Armor +1; Armor +4; UseLimitationRacial
g_a_class9009.description: Special: Upgradeable, Armor  The armor of Cassus Fett, the most wanted man in known space. Famous for killing the captain of a flagship Republic frigate at the Battle of Jaga's Cluster, he is presumed dead.

g_a_class9011.name: Cassus Fett's Battle Armor
g_a_class9011.stat_modifiers: Ability +1; Armor +5; DamageResist; DamageResist; DamageResist; UseLimitationRacial
g_a_class9011.description: Special: Upgradeable, Armor  The armor of Cassus Fett, the most wanted man in known space. Famous for killing the captain of a flagship Republic frigate at the Battle of Jaga's Cluster, he is presumed dead.

g_a_class9002.name: Durasteel Heavy Armor
g_a_class9002.description: Battle armor production is thriving on Bonadan as the Republic recovers from war. This model's thinner skin of durasteel reduces weight, but still restricts movement somewhat.

g_a_class9001.name: Heavy Battle Armor
g_a_class9001.description: This is the heaviest armor available for the soldier that requires maximum protection from direct damage. Some consider the fit claustrophobic, but that's the tradeoff for safety.

g_a_class9005.name: Jurgan Kalta's Power Suit
g_a_class9005.stat_modifiers: DamageResist; DamageResist; DamageResist; DamageResist; DamageResist; DamageResist; Armor +1; Armor +3; Immunity; UseLimitationRacial
g_a_class9005.description: Special: Upgradeable, Armor  Aided by custom armor like this, Jurgan Kalta had no combat equal, so his enemies tried more exotic attacks. It was a gaxxan brain-slug left on a pillow that proved his undoing.

g_a_class9006.name: Jurgan Kalta's Power Suit

g_a_class9007.description: Special: Upgradeable, Armor  Aided by custom armor like this, Jurgan Kalta had no combat equal, so his enemies tried more exotic attacks. It was a gaxxan brain-slug left on a pillow that proved his undoing.

g_a_class9010.name: Mandalorian Assault Armor
g_a_class9010.description: This was the armor of the Mandalorian elite frontline troops, a sight that Republic soldiers were all too familiar with during the war.

g_a_class9003.name: Mandalorian Battle Armor
g_a_class9003.description: Republic soldiers saw this armor all too often during the Mandalorian War. It's understandable that the conflict could drag on when a fanatical enemy is so defensively outfitted.

g_a_class9004.name: Mandalorian Heavy Armor
g_a_class9004.description: This armor is reserved for respected veteran Mandalorians. Immensely sturdy, stabilizers diffuse energy throughout the frame, shielding the wearer from disorienting impacts.

g_i_belt003.name: Adrenaline Amplifier
g_i_belt003.description: This device improves the wearer's reflexes by triggering prolonged bursts of adrenaline. It is thought to be perfectly safe, with only a few instances of uncontrolled muscle spasms.

g_i_belt011.name: Adrenaline Stimulator
g_i_belt011.description: This belt endows the wearer with hyper-sensitivity to their surroundings and dynamically improves reflexes and reaction time.

g_i_belt004.name: Advanced Adrenaline Amplifier
g_i_belt004.description: This device is an improved version of the basic model, increasing effectiveness with fewer occurrences of side effects. It improves reflexes by triggering prolonged bursts of adrenaline.

tar03_brejikbelt.name: Brejik's Belt
tar03_brejikbelt.description: Brejik's belt, when used in conjunction with his arm band, produces an effective barrier against melee attacks.

g_i_belt009.name: Calrissian's Utility Belt
g_i_belt009.description: Galduran Calrissian's name was something of a liability after he became infamous for running an unsanctioned smuggling ring within Hutt space. Eventually cornered, he had to pawn even his personal items to avoid being the last Calrissian. The user must have paid points into the Demolitions and Security skills to gain the respective benefits from this belt.

g_i_belt001.name: Cardio-Regulator
g_i_belt001.description: This belt monitors heartbeat and breathing and releases chemicals into the body should either of these become irregular. This gives the wearer a higher fortitude than most.

g_i_belt012.name: CNS Strength Enhancer
g_i_belt012.description: An experimental system that amplifies power signals along the length of the central nervous system, this generator, attached to a belt, provides greater impulses to all muscles, as well as a resistance to all sorts of perturbations of the user's system.

g_i_belt013.name: Electrical Capacitance Shield
g_i_belt013.description: This shielding device, worn around the waist, absorbs and stores electrical energy directed at the user, which is then released slowly over a period of time, dissipating harmlessly. The manner of release generates vibrations along the inside edge of the shield, giving it the less than complimentary nickname, 'The Tingler'.

g_i_belt005.name: Nerve Amplifier Belt
g_i_belt005.description: This belt monitors the brain, emitting energy waves to reinforce established patterns and block any outside influence. It's extremely effective, if mildly uncomfortable.

tar11_powerbelt.name: Power Belt
tar11_powerbelt.description: Primarily designed for those doing heavy lifting, the power belt has also found use as an enhancement for melee fighters.

g_i_belt014.name: Thermal Shield Generator
g_i_belt014.description: This generator forms a magnetic shield around the wearer which, while ineffective against most modern weaponry, does allow for the ablation of directed heat attacks, generally in the form of fire.

g_i_belt002.name: Verpine Cardio-Regulator
g_i_belt002.description: This device regulates the body in distress with emergency fortitude support for the wearer. It functions so well that some wonder how many "bodies in distress" the Verpine tested.

g_w_blstrcrbn001.name: Blaster Carbine
g_w_blstrcrbn001.description: Created initially by Gungis X Weapons, blaster carbine rifles have become very popular in recent years, helped by falling prices due to competition from other companies.

g_w_blstrcrbn003.name: Cinnagaran Carbine
g_w_blstrcrbn003.description: This blaster rifle variant is one of many fine weapons produced by the factories of Cinnagar in their continued militarizing after the Great Hyperspace War a thousand years ago.

g_w_blstrcrbn005.name: Jamoh Hogra's Carbine
g_w_blstrcrbn005.stat_modifiers: AttackBonus +2; AttackBonus +1; Damage; Damage; Damage; Damage; Enhancement +2
g_w_blstrcrbn005.description: Special: Upgradeable, Ranged  This was the weapon of mercenary Jamoh Hogra, and was supposed to protect him against the many enemies he earned in his lifetime. Hogra's skill didn't match its potential, however.

g_w_blstrcrbn004.description: The Zabrak mercenary Jurgan Kalta commissioned this rifle, a weapon he liked to think of as "amusingly destructive."

g_w_blstrcrbn002.name: Sith Assault Gun
g_w_blstrcrbn002.description: This is a modification on the blaster carbine rarely seen outside of Sith-controlled space.

g_w_blstrcrbn020.name: Sith Assault Gun
g_w_blstrcrbn020.description: This is a modification on the blaster carbine rarely seen outside of Sith-controlled space.

g_w_blstrpstl003.name: Arkanian Pistol
g_w_blstrpstl003.description: This is a versatile blaster variant, possibly of ancient Arkanian origin. The Arkanians are very proud that such early efforts continue to be prized among collectors and soldiers.

g_w_blstrpstl005.name: Bendak's Blaster
g_w_blstrpstl005.description: Special: Upgradeable, Ranged  This blaster belonged to Bendak Starkiller, a duelist legendary on Taris. It is a highly adaptable weapon, and is definitely of better quality than any standard issue pistol.

g_w_blstrpstl009.description: Special: Upgradeable, Ranged  This blaster belonged to Bendak Starkiller, a duelist legendary on Taris. It is a highly adaptable weapon, and is definitely of better quality than any standard issue pistol.

g_w_blstrpstl001.name: Blaster Pistol
g_w_blstrpstl001.description: The most common ranged weapon in the galaxy is the basic blaster pistol, firing a bolt of intense coherent light powered by a replaceable power pack.

carth_temp_gun.name: Carth's Blaster
carth_temp_gun.stat_modifiers: AttackBonus +2; AttackBonus +1; Damage; Damage; Damage; Damage; Use_Limitation_Feat; Use_Limitation_Feat
carth_temp_gun.description: Special: Upgradeable, Ranged  Carth's personal blaster is based on an old Arkanian design, but he has adapted it to incorporate all of the latest modular technology available to the Republic.

g_w_blstrpstl010.name: Carth's Blaster
g_w_blstrpstl010.description: Special: Upgradeable, Ranged  Carth's personal blaster is based on an old Arkanian design, but he has adapted it to incorporate all of the latest modular technology available to the Republic.

geno_blaster.name: GenoHaradan Blaster
geno_blaster.description: The GenoHaradan created this blaster as a tool to strike against well-protected assassination targets. It's remarkable accuracy makes it the perfect weapon for precision, long range strikes.

g_w_blstrpstl020.name: Insta-kill Pistol
g_w_blstrpstl020.description: The most common weapon of bravados and smugglers, the blaster pistol fires a high-energy particle beam designed for short-range combat.

g_w_blstrpstl002.name: Mandalorian Blaster
g_w_blstrpstl002.description: The Mandalorian Blaster is a slightly more powerful version of the basic pistol common throughout the galaxy.

g_w_blstrpstl004.name: Zabrak Blaster Pistol
g_w_blstrpstl004.description: This blaster is the staple of the Zabrak mercenary, known for deadly accuracy and exceptional damage.

g_w_blstrrfl001.name: Blaster Rifle
g_w_blstrrfl001.description: More powerful than the commonly available pistol, the blaster rifle is favored by soldiers throughout the galaxy. Civilian ownership of these weapons is not generally encouraged.

g_w_blstrrfl020.name: Blaster Rifle
g_w_blstrrfl020.description: More powerful than the commonly available pistol, the blaster rifle is favored by soldiers throughout the galaxy. Civilian ownership of these weapons is not generally encouraged.

g_w_blstrrfl003.description: These weapons are almost overpowered for their size, but the Mandalorians prefer them that way. They do not make a habit of being subtle in their war making.

g_w_blstrrfl002.name: Sith Sniper Rifle
g_w_blstrrfl002.description: Despite its effectiveness, these modified blaster rifles are not often employed by the Sith. They prefer to engage their enemies up close and personal.

g_w_blstrrfl004.name: Zabrak Battle Cannon
g_w_blstrrfl004.description: These weapons are almost beginning to cross the line to light artillery. Armor is generally ineffective against such a weapon, unless it is of the highest quality.

g_w_bowcstr001.name: Bowcaster
g_w_bowcstr001.description: The bowcaster is an invention of the Wookiees of Kashyyyk. Also called a laser crossbow, it actually uses a magnetic accelerator to hurl an explosive energy quarrel at its target.

g_w_bowcstr002.name: Chuundar's Bowcaster
g_w_bowcstr002.description: Chuundar's personal weapon is a bowcaster with some unusual Czerka modifications. Most Wookiees would likely not appreciate such outside influence.

g_w_bowcstr003.name: Zaalbar's Bowcaster
g_w_bowcstr003.description: Special: Upgradeable, Ranged  This is Zaalbar's personal bowcaster. He has made modifications to it over the years, but it still tightly conforms to the traditions of his people.

g_i_collarlgt001.name: Collar Light
g_i_collarlgt001.description: This convenient collar light frees up the user's hands from having to carry a glow rod or similar device.

g_i_cmbtshot001.name: Battle Stimulant
g_i_cmbtshot001.description: Bonus: Vitality max +8pts Attack: +1 Damage: +1 Duration: 120 secs  This stimulant enables the user to better absorb damage and focuses the mind on the fight, improving the ability to hit. The effect wears off after a short time. Stim bonuses that affect the same statistic do not stack.

g_i_cmbtshot003.name: Echani Battle Stimulant
g_i_cmbtshot003.description: Bonus: Vitality max +25pts Attack: +3 Damage: +3 Duration: 120 secs  This stimulant produces a chemical cocktail that sends a boost of adrenaline through the body, focusing the mind and bolstering the user's tolerance for damage. Stim bonuses that affect the same statistic do not stack.

g_i_cmbtshot002.name: Hyper-battle Stimulant
g_i_cmbtshot002.description: Bonus: Vitality max +16pts Attack: +2 Damage: +2 Duration: 120 secs  This stim removes all distractions, allowing the user to focus purely on the battle. The user is almost oblivious to damage suffered. Stim bonuses that affect the same statistic do not stack.

g_w_cryobgren001.name: CryoBan Grenade
g_w_cryobgren001.description: Damage: Cold, 20pts Secondary: Paralyzation for 6sec Area of Effect: 4m Range: Long Save: DC15 for half damage, negates paralyzation  A CryoBan grenade releases a supercooled liquid that freezes on contact, causing intense pain and damage to victims caught in the effect.

kor_itm_sithtabl.name: Ancient Sith Tablet
kor_itm_sithtabl.description: This thick stone tablet is covered with ancient runes of an unknown language. It is extremely cold to the touch and has almost a sinister aura about it. Recently carved into the side of the tablet appears to be a primer... no doubt intended to provide a means to translate the runes.

tar05_bekplan.name: Bek Datapad
tar05_bekplan.description: This datapad seems to detail plans the Hidden Bek had to get into the Black Vulkar base.  Of note is the following:  "We have synthesized a substance with an odor that resembles a favorite prey of rancors. If we place the bait properly, we can lure the rancor into eating something lethal enough to kill it."

dan14_diary.name: Casus' Diary
dan14_diary.description: This is the diary of Casus Sandral, amateur archeologist. It details his efforts to discover the source of the ancient ruins found across the surface of Dantooine. Upon reading it, you gather that he had found some correlation between the ruins and something called the 'Rak'.

k38a_itm_data.name: Data Recorder
k38a_itm_data.description: The data recorder flashes to life:  I haven't been able to catch my poor creation as yet. We've been trying to capture it without destroying it; the thing is too valuable. It is hard to be so quiet as is necessary, however; it identifies targets through sound. I'm glad we brought sound dampeners with us. Provided that idiot Ben Hu'al uses his.

datapad.name: Datapad
datapad.description: This datapad appears to contain numerous entries of notes made by Master Uthar of the Sith Academy. Most prominent of the recent entries is the following:  "The pupil known as Dustil has shown remarkable progress. His talent with the Force is great. The same, however, cannot be said for the human female that he arrived with, Selene. She has little talent. Moreover, Dustil holds a great degree of affection for her. This is a weakness in the boy and has been slowing down his training. Orders were sent this morning to have the girl removed from the academy and terminated. I will tell Dustil that she was killed in the valley. He will forget her soon enough, I think... he is too promising to lose at this juncture."

g_i_datapad001.name: Datapad
g_i_datapad001.description: Data storage devices like these are common, though they may vary in quality depending on what features are included.

geno_datapad.name: Datapad
geno_datapad.description: This datapad contains a single short, cryptic message: The Genoharadan say to see Hulas on Manaan. Come alone or not at all.

grarwwaar_pad.name: Datapad
grarwwaar_pad.description: This datapad appears to be a diary or record of some kind. The final entry is of particular interest:  "We were fools to come down here, all of us. How can we hope to capture an enemy that can assume any shape, any form?  We lost two the first day, another three disappeared the day after that. Our enemy's bloodlust knows no limits.  We found Grarwwaar's body last night: what was left of it. If we do not leave the Shadowlands soon, I fear we will all become victims of the Faceless One."

kas22_datapad.name: Datapad
kas22_datapad.description: Bastila has escaped Taris. Whoever can find and dispose of her and her Jedi companion will be greatly rewarded by Lord Malak himself.

kor37_datapad01.name: Datapad
kor37_datapad01.description: The datapad appears to be the journal of a Sith archaeologist by the name of Veren Gal. Most of it consists of uninteresting notes on the geology of the tomb's caverns, but the final entry is as follows:  "Strangely enough, I've found traces of Therangen in the tomb. This is an unstable black rock used as fuel by lesser races... perhaps the ancient Sith on Korriban used it as a power source? It is a volatile and dangerous substance, and reacts violently to fire. I will have to be careful."

kor37_datapad02.name: Datapad
kor37_datapad02.description: This datapad seems to have once belonged to an enterprising young Sith student who had ventured into the tomb in search of Ajunta Pall's sword. One of his entries is of particular note:  "There has got to be a way to get past this obelisk blocking the bridge! It seems to be made of some kind of unstable material... I'm willing to bet some kind of energy discharge will set it off. Blaster fire isn't doing the trick, however. I'll have to try some kind of explosive. I just hope that guard droid over there is as defunct as it looks."

kor39_itm_datapd.name: Datapad
kor39_itm_datapd.description: This datapad appears to be the journal of a Sith who quite obviously did not make it past this portion of his final test. Most of the journal consists of the Sith's account of gaining enough prestige with Master Uthar to take this test... only the final entry appears to concern the test, itself:  "It seems I need to get across the pool of acid in the central chamber if I am to complete my test, here, but that is not going to be easy. The runes name one obelisk the 'Pillar of Fire'... while the other is the 'Pillar of Ice'. I can only assume that one of the pillars leads to a way to remove the acid pool. Fire or ice... wouldn't fire create toxic fumes? I'm not sure. Maybe freezing the pool would be safer. Well... I'll worry about that once I bypass the terentatek beasts. If I can. I suppose it's now or never."

tat17_datapad.name: Datapad
tat17_datapad.description: This datapad contains detailed descriptions of you and Bastila. It also has a brief message: Bastila has escaped Taris. Whoever can find and dispose of her and her Jedi companion will be greatly rewarded by Lord Malak himself.

unk44_data.name: Datapad
unk44_data.description: Novice Sith such as yourself cannot be trusted to remember even simple tasks, acolyte. It is therefore prudent for your masters to explain themselves at length, using very small words. The ancient sequencer on the lower levels can only be activated once all the sequencer tiles on the floor have been set to their active mode by walking on them in the correct pattern. To make all the tiles the same color, simply walk the tiles in the pattern of an 'H'. I trust there will not be another unfortunate 'incident' like the last time...

unk_researchpad.name: Datapad
unk_researchpad.description: This data pad contains information from many genetics studies conducted by the Rakata during their technological peak.

vorndata.name: Datapad
vorndata.description: There is a message on this datapad, though it is unclear if Vorn meant to send it to someone, or if someone sent it to him.  The guild is restless. Genoharadan agents are hunting. Soon they will come for me - and possibly for you.  When they do, I plan to be ready.

duronjournal.name: Duron's Journal
duronjournal.description: This data pad appears to be the personal journal of the Jedi Duron Qel-Droma. The last entry reveals what he was doing on this world:  Korriban is everything I imagined - and feared. I can feel the power of the dark side here, I can sense the terentatek hiding in this evil place.  Shaela and I have decided to venture forth into the Valley of the Sith Lords in search of the creatures. I only wish Guun Han was still with us.  Why couldn't he just accept that Shaela and I are in love? He claims our passion for each other will lead us down the dark side, but he can't even see how his own pride and arrogance are leading him away from the light.   Maybe it is good that he left, after all. Even as dangerous as the terentatek are, I'm certain Shaela and I can defeat one without his help.

guunjournal.name: Guun Han's Journal
guunjournal.description: This data pad was recovered from the remains of a terentatek on Kashyyyk, and must have been devoured by the beast. It appears to be the personal journal of Guun Han Saresh. The last entry explains what he was doing on Kashyyyk:  Duran and Shaela have given in to their passion for each other, and are doomed to fall to the dark side. I tried to warn them against expressing their love, but they called me arrogant and accused me - ME! - of being the one on the dark path. I left the fools on Korriban.  But I am not about to abandon the mandate given me by the Jedi Council. I will destroy the terentatek wherever I find them. I have heard rumors such a beast may exist in the Shadowlands of Kashyyyk.  I shall go there and slay the beast, proving that I do not need either Duran or Shaela with me to defeat these creatures!

g_manaanvis.name: Manaan Visitor's Guide
g_manaanvis.description: Welcome traveler, to exciting and adventurous Manaan!    Manaan, the only source of the healing kolto in the entire galaxy, is a wonderful and refreshing place to visit or do business. The Manaan Port Authority welcomes beings of all species and affiliations to trade peacefully within the confines of Ahto City.    All visitors will rest easy knowing that the Selkath Security Forces are always alert and watchful, even while you sleep. Our constant vigilance keeps the peace on the streets of Ahto City and prevents the needless interruption of commerce by violence.    Enjoy a fun and prosperous stay on Manaan and, please, tell your friends about Manaan!

g_i_datapad002.name: Mandalorian Datapad
g_i_datapad002.description: Jarg, did you remember not to take the XT-model bike out today?  There was something funny with one of the intakes, and I thought it could jam.   Ha!  Consider yourself lucky!  If someone was dumb enough to take that thing out he would have ploughed right into the ground within a kilometer.

g_mandat1.description: Jarg, did you remember not to take the XT-model bike out today?  There was something funny with one of the intakes, and I thought it could jam.   Ha!  Consider yourself lucky!  If someone was dumb enough to take that thing out he would have ploughed right into the ground within a kilometer.

g_mandat2.name: Mandalorian Datapad
g_mandat2.description: Jarg went missing in Sector B, then Reeza saw someone moving south of there.  Take a couple troops and find out who it is.   If they look suspicious: terminate.

g_mandat3.name: Mandalorian Datapad
g_mandat3.description: Tandore, the damn farmers in Sector E aren't giving up their stuff.  We're going to go pay them a visit and crush the spirit out of them.  Make sure no one runs across this stash, or Sherruk will have your hide!   We're going to meet with him south of the Matale estate in a couple hours, and go from there. Don't screw it up this time!

kas25_datapad1.name: Mandalorian Datapad 1
kas25_datapad1.description: This request is in the Mandalorian language. "A stump disabled the stabilizers on my swoop. I request parts before other systems fail. If the generator goes, my blending field will stop working and I'll be visible to our prey."

kas25_datapad2.name: Mandalorian Datapad 2
kas25_datapad2.description: This is a personal log in the Mandalorian language. "This hunt is no challenge. How will attacking unarmed creatures train us to use these Jedi toys? You want new warriors to learn? Watching a comrade lop his own arm off fighting a real opponent would teach more than these pointless battles. I obey, Mandalore, but with protest. The blending field generators on the swoops grant near perfect camouflage. Why only attack unarmed opponents?"

g_scijournal.name: Scientist's Memo
g_scijournal.description: In response to those firaxan sharks outside I managed to whip up a little something in one of the workrooms. This is a sonic emitter which should scare them off. The sound seems to work a lot better underwater than through the air and if you fix it on the outside of an envirosuit, just push the button every time they get near and you'll have no problems.   So I was just wondering... when am I going to get that raise?                       -- Caal Jordan

shaelajournal.name: Shaela's Journal
shaelajournal.description: This data pad is the personal journal of the Jedi Shaela Nur. Her last entry is particularly compelling:  I have tracked the terentatek that ambushed us in the Shyrack caves to this tomb, but even as I stand at the entrance I know this is wrong.  Dark thoughts fill my mind: hatred and vengeance. I cannot stop myself from blaming Guun Han for Duran's death. If he had not abandoned us, my love would surely have survived the terentatek's first attack.  But my hatred of Guun Han pales beside my burning desire for revenge. My blood boils to destroy the creature that ended Duran's life, no matter what the cost.   I know such thoughts are those of the dark side, but I cannot help them. Even the second set of tracks outside the cave cannot dissuade me from my task. One terentatek, two, a thousand... it makes no difference to me now.  The only image I see is that of Duran's broken body, and only blood can cleanse it from my mind.  I hope my Master will forgive me for what I am about to do.

k35_itm_sithdata.name: Sith Datapad
k35_itm_sithdata.description: This datapad contains coded instructions from Master Uthar to someone by the name of Adrenas. You are not sure what the instructions detail, save that he requires the chamberlain to go to Dreshdae to gather the ingredients.

ptar_sithpapers.name: Sith Papers
ptar_sithpapers.description: These official looking papers identify the bearer as being on special assignment by order of the Sith government of Taris. They also warn of gruesome penalties for anyone foolish enough to challenge the bearer.

kas24_datapad.name: Slaver Contract
kas24_datapad.description: This datapad card contains a contract to trade weapons for slaves, and a manifest of goods already delivered. It would seem that Rorworr had sold a number of Wookiees previously, and intended to do so again.

kas25_datapad.name: Swoop Bike Signal Device
kas25_datapad.description: This device attaches to a swoop bike , transmitting any field data that has been collected on it to the Commander.

g_puzdat.name: Water Pump Analysis
g_puzdat.description: Commander Hasek:   In regards to the system in place to cycle water from the ocean to the thermal heaters:   What were you thinking?!? What made you put that airlock mechanism on the only other path to the north side of the base?? Now everyone has to know how to cycle the water out of one room and into the adjoining one for each of the three rooms in sequence without accidentally flooding the room they're in. We lost seven troopers just this week!   Next time I'm there you better show me how to do it properly! I can't afford to lose any more of my aides while trying to get to the Selkath!  Adjutant:   Sorry, sir, but we had to change the pump mechanism since one of those fish people swam into one of the intakes outside.   The external flow controls push the water into the chambers north and south only now. The flow controls on the inside wall switches the water between sides east and west.   The trick now is to push the water to the north and south extremes, then switch the water east-west and walk through. The meters by the flow control panels show if there is water in the adjacent room. We've also installed lifeform detection sensors, so there shouldn't be anymore aide problems...   We're trying to get the system passed as quickly as possible, sir, but the Selkath authorities monitoring our base have made this much more difficult.

tat17_sandperdis.name: Sand People Clothing
tat17_sandperdis.description: These are the intricate robes of a Sand People warrior. They seem to be in good condition, and might allow a wearer to superficially appear to be a member of the Sand People species.

ptar_sitharmor.name: Sith Armor
ptar_sitharmor.description: This full body armor could be used to fool people into thinking the wearer was one of the Sith.

g_w_dsrptpstl001.name: Disruptor Pistol
g_w_dsrptpstl001.description: These pistols are illegal in many planetary systems, being regarded as too powerful a weapon to be owned by civilians. Disruptors reduce solid matter to its constituent molecules. Unlike typical blasters, disruptors ignore most types of personal energy shields.

g_w_dsrptpstl002.name: Mandalorian Ripper
g_w_dsrptpstl002.description: A weapon similar to this energy-propelled slug-thrower belonged to Jigger Wraith, a bounty hunter who plagued the Republic years ago. Thirty-seven Mandalorians were executed for being him until sightings declined. As a type of disruptor, this weapon ignores most personal energy shields.

g1_w_dsrptrfl001.name: Baragwin Disruptor-X Weapon
g1_w_dsrptrfl001.stat_modifiers: AttackBonus +1; AttackBonus +1; Damage; Damage; Damage; Damage; Keen
g1_w_dsrptrfl001.description: Special: Upgradeable, Ranged  Using the same 'shaped-energy' concept as in his Ion-X Weapon, Suvam Tan has modified a Baragwin disruptor weapon as well, giving comparable levels of concussive force to the blast that the Ion-X Weapon delivers. Upgrades to this weapon could potentially greatly increase both the impact force and the penetration of its charges.

g_w_dsrptrfl001.name: Disruptor Rifle
g_w_dsrptrfl001.description: This disruptor is even more destructive than its pistol counterpart, and is outlawed on just as many worlds. Disruptors reduce solid matter to its constituent molecules. Painfully. Unlike typical blasters, disruptors ignore most types of personal energy shields.

g_w_dsrptrfl002.name: Zabrak Disruptor Cannon
g_w_dsrptrfl002.description: Zabrak always command respect, especially with the aid of weapons that are even more damaging than already-outlawed standard disruptors. Unlike typical blasters, disruptors ignore most types of personal energy shields.
