g_w_dblswrd005.name: Ajunta Pall's Blade
g_w_dblswrd005.description: Held by the Dark Jedi even before he fell to the dark side, this may be one of the few truly personal items owned by Ajunta Pall, and remains as thoroughly corrupted as he.

k37_itm_ajunta.name: Ajunta Pall's Blade
k37_itm_ajunta.description: Held by the Dark Jedi even before he fell to the dark side, this may be one of the few truly personal items owned by Ajunta Pall, and remains as thoroughly corrupted as he.

g_w_dblswrd001.name: Double-Bladed Sword
g_w_dblswrd001.description: A difficult weapon to master, the double bladed sword has a grip in the center with two long blades emerging from either end. The double-bladed sword is capable of inflicting more damage - but is also less precise - than the single-bladed variant.

g_w_dblswrd002.name: Echani Ritual Brand
g_w_dblswrd002.description: Echani Firedancers use the double bladed Ritual Brand in a dodging and slicing pattern so graceful it looks more like a dance than combat.

g_w_dblswrd003.name: Krath Double Sword
g_w_dblswrd003.description: Twisted by the dark side, the Krath favored weapons of fearsome appearance requiring brute strength to wield, and the blades of this weapon are certainly effective, if not elegant.

k37_itm_freedont.name: Notched Steel Sword
k37_itm_freedont.description: The blade of this sword is an ebony black and notched along its length to give it a cruel and jagged appearance. There is a strange visual effect upon the sword which makes it seem as if shadows pulse and ebb along its surface. It is very cool to the touch, and upon close inspection a small insignia of a dark circle can be spotted on its hilt.

g_i_drdcomspk003.name: Advanced Computer Tool
g_i_drdcomspk003.description: Like the basic unit, this retractable probe allows droid access to the higher programming functions of any computer terminal, though better interface adapters make it more effective.

g1_i_drdcomspk01.name: Advanced Droid Interface
g1_i_drdcomspk01.description: A self-contained artificial intelligence system, this module can be equipped on droids to provide them with additional resources useful in the bypassing of computer and conventional security systems. This AI extends the current capabilities of the mounting droid to a level typically only seen on military espionage droids.

g_i_drdcomspk001.name: Computer Probe
g_i_drdcomspk001.description: This retractable probe allows droid access to the higher programming functions of any computer terminal. Better quality probes provide cleaner access, increasing functionality.

g_i_drdcomspk002.name: Universal Computer Interface
g_i_drdcomspk002.description: The best and most expensive of its type available, this retractable probe allows droid access to the higher programming functions of any computer terminal.

g1_i_drdhvplat01.name: Composite Heavy Plating
g1_i_drdhvplat01.description: This plating forgoes mobility in favor of sheer mass. The huge composite plates covering the droid do not allow the range of motion that other armor systems may grant their user, but in terms of physical protection, this plating is the best in the galaxy.

g_i_drdhvplat001.name: Droid Heavy Plating Type 1
g_i_drdhvplat001.description: Originally used on starship hulls, durasteel is the best protection available for droids. This particular variant of the alloy is the standard for mass-production heavy combat droids.

g_i_drdhvplat002.name: Droid Heavy Plating Type 2
g_i_drdhvplat002.description: A specialized variant of heavy plating, this type of durasteel alloy is not sold in mass quantities. More often, it is used to equip elite troops where the initial cost of the battle droid warrants the investment.

g_i_drdhvplat003.name: Droid Heavy Plating Type 3
g_i_drdhvplat003.description: The heaviest protection available, this type of plating is uncommon due to the cost involved in production. It is best suited to specialized assassin or assault droids, though such units are highly regulated.

g_i_drdltplat001.name: Droid Light Plating Type 1
g_i_drdltplat001.description: A thin sheet of alloy plating is a relatively inexpensive way to improve a droid's chance of surviving combat. This model is an excellent option for light-duty droids.

g_i_drdltplat002.name: Droid Light Plating Type 2
g_i_drdltplat002.description: Though more for the factory floor, plating of this type is seeing more general use. Light but effective, this upgrade can mean the difference between repair and replacement if a droid comes to harm.

g_i_drdltplat003.name: Droid Light Plating Type 3
g_i_drdltplat003.description: The strongest of the light-grade plating, this is the best protection most individuals consider purchasing for droids not actively in a class intended for combat.

g_i_drdmdplat001.name: Droid Medium Plating Type 1
g_i_drdmdplat001.description: Developed by engineer Hoot Calin, this plating relies more on deflecting angles than exotic alloys. Cost can be prohibitive, though this is the most affordable model of the type.

g_i_drdmdplat002.name: Droid Medium Plating Type 2
g_i_drdmdplat002.description: This version of the Calin Industries plating system signaled a company shift in production from construction droids to military models. It now sees use on many different worlds.

g_i_drdmdplat003.name: Droid Medium Plating Type 3
g_i_drdmdplat003.description: To solidify its place in the market, Calin Industries introduced this specialty variant of their medium plating system. Only heavy plating protects better, though the cost is prohibitive for some.

g_i_drdmtnsen001.name: Droid Motion Sensors Type 1
g_i_drdmtnsen001.description: These devices allow a droid to better detect creatures hidden by stealth fields. This basic model is the most inexpensive of the type, and is commonly available on many worlds.

g_i_drdmtnsen002.name: Droid Motion Sensors Type 2
g_i_drdmtnsen002.description: This sensor package greatly enhances droid vision, increasing the likelihood of detecting creatures hidden by stealth fields. This model is marketed mainly to manufacturers of sentry and combat droids.

g_i_drdmtnsen003.name: Droid Motion Sensors Type 3
g_i_drdmtnsen003.description: Incorporating the most sophisticated sensors available, this model of upgrade is usually purchased for special-duty droids guarding sensitive materials or galactic heads of state.

g_i_drdrepeqp002.name: Advanced Repair Kit
g_i_drdrepeqp002.description: Included are an improved assortment of tools and parts needed for a droid to repair itself after being damaged in combat. This kit can't be used by living beings. Advanced kits repair 25 vitality points + INT modifier + (2 x user's skill in Repair).

g_i_drdrepeqp003.name: Construction Kit
g_i_drdrepeqp003.description: This kit contains all the necessary parts for a droid to repair itself after being damaged in combat, including electrical regulators designed to isolate malfunctions. This kit can't be used by living beings. Construction kits repair 35 vitality points + INT modifier + (3 x user's skill in Repair).

g_i_drdrepeqp001.name: Repair Kit
g_i_drdrepeqp001.description: Included are the basic tools needed for a droid to repair itself after being damaged in combat. This kit can't be used by living beings. Basic kits repair 15 vitality points + INT modifier + user's skill in Repair.

g_i_drdsrcscp001.name: Droid Search Scope Type 1
g_i_drdsrcscp001.description: These detectors help droids scan for traps or other security measures. Cost increases with quality, though success depends mostly on the complexity of the device to be detected.

g_i_drdsrcscp002.name: Droid Search Scope Type 2
g_i_drdsrcscp002.description: These detectors help droids scan for traps or other security measures. Cost increases with quality, though success depends mostly on the complexity of the device to be detected.

g_i_drdsrcscp003.name: Droid Search Scope Type 3
g_i_drdsrcscp003.description: These detectors help droids scan for traps or other security measures. Cost increases with quality, though success depends mostly on the complexity of the device to be detected.

g_i_drdsecspk003.name: Security Decryption Interface
g_i_drdsecspk003.description: This model of security breaker is no longer in production. It was an effective option before the factories of Toshan Gant took over the market. A droid must have basic Security software (paid points into the skill) to benefit from this item.

g_i_drdsecspk002.name: Security Domination Interface
g_i_drdsecspk002.description: Modified on the aftermarket, this Toshan Gant security breaker is the best available. A droid must have basic Security software (paid points into the skill) to benefit from this item.

g_i_drdsecspk001.name: Security Interface Tool
g_i_drdsecspk001.description: Pioneered by Toshan Gant, this is the basic droid security breaker in use across the galaxy. Gant did most of his research for the Republic military after private efforts led to his imprisonment. A droid must have basic Security software (paid points into the skill) to benefit from this item.

g1_i_drdshld001.name: Baragwin Droid Shield
g1_i_drdshld001.description: A super-efficient version of a normal droid energy shield, the Baragwin version has been modified and customized to be able to run off the power supply of the droid mounting it. While the energy drain on the droid is insignificant, the protection gained is equal, if not superior, to a normal light droid energy shield.

g_i_drdshld008.name: Droid Shield
g_i_drdshld008.stat_modifiers: CastSpell; Use_Limitation_Feat; Immunity; Immunity; Immunity; Immunity
g_i_drdshld008.description: Deflection: Energy, Sonic, Cold, Heat, Electrical 50pts total  Duration: 200 seconds, or max damage taken  Charges: Using this item consumes one charge. This item is automatically discarded after all available charges are consumed. Items that have charges do not stack in inventory.  This variant of environmental shielding is designed for frontline combat droids. It provides broad protection against many effects, but the power drain is significant when it is equipped and activated, and it must be replaced regularly.

g_i_drdshld001.name: Energy Shield Level 1
g_i_drdshld001.description: Deflection: Energy, 20pts Duration: 200 seconds, or max damage taken  This is a basic model energy shield universally applicable to most droids. The power drain is significant, however, and units like this must be replaced regularly.

g_i_drdshld002.name: Energy Shield Level 2
g_i_drdshld002.description: Deflection: Energy, 30pts Duration: 200 seconds, or max damage taken  Upgraded from the basic portable energy shield, these units are marketed to companies and governments that keep large standing forces of combat droids. The power drain is significant, however, and they must be replaced regularly.

g_i_drdshld003.name: Energy Shield Level 3
g_i_drdshld003.description: Deflection: Energy, 50pts Duration: 200 seconds, or max damage taken  This sophisticated item is designed for top quality combat droids, and produces superior protection for any droid with the necessary software to install it. The power drain is significant, however, and it must be replaced regularly.

g_i_drdshld005.name: Environment Shield Level 1
g_i_drdshld005.description: Deflection: Energy, Sonic, Cold, Heat, 20pts total Duration: 200 seconds, or max damage taken  Initially designed to resist the harsh conditions of factory floors, these shields provide a droid with basic protection against a broad array of effects. The power drain is significant, however, and they must be replaced regularly.

g_i_drdshld006.name: Environment Shield Level 2
g_i_drdshld006.description: Deflection: Energy, Sonic, Cold, Heat, 30pts total Duration: 200 seconds, or max damage taken  This unit is an aftermarket modification of the shielding typically found on deep-core mining droids. It provides broad protection against many effects, but the power drain is significant and it must be replaced regularly.

g_i_drdshld007.name: Environment Shield Level 3
g_i_drdshld007.description: Deflection: Energy, Sonic, Cold, Heat, 50pts total Duration: 200 seconds, or max damage taken  This variant of environmental shielding is designed for frontline combat droids. It provides broad protection against many effects, but the power drain is significant and it must be replaced regularly.

g_i_drdsncsen001.name: Droid Sonic Sensors Type 1
g_i_drdsncsen001.description: These devices allow detection of hidden or visually camouflaged intruders. Better quality sensors provide more sensitive background noise filtering to improve performance.

g_i_drdsncsen002.name: Droid Sonic Sensors Type 2
g_i_drdsncsen002.description: These devices allow detection of hidden or visually camouflaged intruders. Better quality sensors provide more sensitive background noise filtering to improve performance.

g_i_drdsncsen003.name: Droid Sonic Sensors Type 3
g_i_drdsncsen003.description: These devices allow detection of hidden or visually camouflaged intruders. Better quality sensors provide more sensitive background noise filtering to improve performance.

g_i_drdtrgcom002.name: Advanced Targeting Computer
g_i_drdtrgcom002.description: Meant for droids that see regular combat, this targeting unit improves on the basic model and greatly increases battlefield performance.

g_i_drdtrgcom001.name: Basic Targeting Computer
g_i_drdtrgcom001.description: Battle droids come factory-ready for combat, but it is still wise to invest in targeting computer upgrades to optimize performance at range. Cost rises with quality, as always.

g_i_drdtrgcom006.name: Bothan Demolitions Probe
g_i_drdtrgcom006.description: Concerning demolitions, the Bothans prefer well-equipped droids for the task of explosives management, and invest research accordingly. A droid must have basic Demolitions software (paid points into the skill) to benefit from this item.

g_i_drdtrgcom004.name: Sensor Probe
g_i_drdtrgcom004.description: This basic probe improves a droid's demolitions capabilities, allowing for more sensitive adjustments of volatile substances. A droid must have basic Demolitions software (paid points into the skill) to benefit from this item.

g_i_drdtrgcom003.name: Superior Targeting Computer
g_i_drdtrgcom003.description: Reserved for the highest quality battle droids, targeting units of this type are rarely seen outside of military operations.

g_i_drdtrgcom005.name: Verpine Demolitions Probe
g_i_drdtrgcom005.description: Wartime contracts over the last forty years saw a great deal of money poured into Verpine droid modifications, particularly in the area of demolitions. A droid must have basic Demolitions software (paid points into the skill) to benefit from this item.

g_i_drdutldev011.name: Adv. Gravity Generator
g_i_drdutldev011.description: Damage: None  On Hit: Slowed, 100% for 9sec  Save: DC20 to negate slow  Charges: Using this item consumes one charge. This item is automatically discarded after all available charges are consumed. Items that have charges do not stack in inventory.  This device creates a more powerful gravity swell than the basic unit due to an unregulated energy governor. The use of such items is discouraged because of concern over environmental effects.

g_i_drdutldev007.name: Advanced Flame Thrower
g_i_drdutldev007.description: Damage: Heat, 60pts  On Hit: Horror, 100% for 3sec  Special: Targets 7th level and up ignore horror effect  Save: DC20 for  half damage  Range: Short  Charges: Using this item consumes one charge. This item is automatically discarded after all available charges are consumed. Items that have charges do not stack in inventory.  Intended as a combat upgrade and not generally avaliable to the public, this droid-mounted weapon can inflict a great deal of damage over a broad area. It is widely used by Republic forces.

g_i_drdutldev012.name: Advanced Flame Thrower
g_i_drdutldev012.description: Damage: Heat, 60pts  On Hit: Horror, 100% for 3sec  Special: Targets 7th level and up ignore horror effect  Save: DC20 for  half damage  Range: Short  Charges: Using this item consumes one charge. This item is automatically discarded after all available charges are consumed. Items that have charges do not stack in inventory.  Intended as a combat upgrade and not generally avaliable to the public, this droid-mounted weapon can inflict a great deal of damage over a broad area. It is widely used by Republic forces.

g_i_drdutldev004.name: Advanced Shield Disruptor
g_i_drdutldev004.description: Damage: Ion, 40pts  Range: Medium  Charges: Using this item consumes one charge. This item is automatically discarded after all available charges are consumed. Items that have charges do not stack in inventory.  Prototyped by Czerka Corporation, these extremely devastating droid and shield nullifiers have found their way to forces on both sides of the Sith/Republic conflict.

g_i_drdutldev002.name: Advanced Stun Ray
g_i_drdutldev002.description: Damage: None  On Hit: Stun, 100% for 9sec  Save: DC20 to negate stun  Range: Medium  Charges: Using this item consumes one charge. This item is automatically discarded after all available charges are consumed. Items that have charges do not stack in inventory.  This product is a special order aftermarket modification of a Quellegh Industrial stun ray. Very expensive to produce, most are in the hands of government-sponsored elite troops.

g1_i_drdutldev01.name: Baragwin Flame Thrower
g1_i_drdutldev01.description: Using an innovative technique, the Baragwin have managed to modify a normal flame thrower to operate in such a fashion as to ignite the very atmosphere around a charged guidance beam. The result is a flame thrower that doesn't need an external fuel source and can be run virtually indefinitely.

g1_i_drdutldev03.name: Baragwin Shield Disruptor
g1_i_drdutldev03.description: The Baragwin have tweaked and tuned a normal Shield Disruptor to be able to run off the mounting droid's power supply, giving it unlimited charges.

g1_i_drdutldev02.name: Baragwin Stun Ray
g1_i_drdutldev02.description: While not the most powerful of weapons, the Baragwin have modified a normal Stun Ray to run at such efficiency that it can tap into the power supply of the droid mounting it, giving it unlimited charges.

g_i_drdutldev008.name: Carbonite Projector
g_i_drdutldev008.description: Damage: Cold, 20pts  On Hit:  Paralyze, 100% for 9sec  Save: DC15 for half damage, paralyze reduced to 3sec  Range: Medium  Charges: Using this item consumes one charge. This item is automatically discarded after all available charges are consumed. Items that have charges do not stack in inventory.  The inverse of a flamethrower, this weapon uses a carbonite freezing technique to super-cool synthetic compounds hurled at a target. This unconventional weapon has not yet seen widespread use.

g_i_drdutldev009.name: Carbonite Projector Mark II
g_i_drdutldev009.description: Damage: Cold, 40pts  On Hit: Paralyze, 100% for 15sec  Save: DC20 for half damage, paralyze reduced to 9sec  Range: Medium  Charges: Using this item consumes one charge. This item is automatically discarded after all available charges are consumed. Items that have charges do not stack in inventory.  Like the basic model, this weapon uses a carbonite freezing technique to super-cool synthetic compounds hurled at a target, though more efficient projectors make it far more effective.

g_i_drdutldev006.name: Flame Thrower
g_i_drdutldev006.description: Damage: Heat, 30pts  On Hit: Horror, 100% for 3sec  Special: Targets 7th level and up ignore horror effect  Save: DC15 for half damage  Range: Short  Charges: Using this item consumes one charge. This item is automatically discarded after all available charges are consumed. Items that have charges do not stack in inventory.  This droid-mounted weapon can inflict damage over a broad area. The incendiary compounds within border on military quality, though the unit was initially designed for industrial purposes.

g_i_drdutldev010.name: Gravity Generator
g_i_drdutldev010.description: Damage: None  On Hit: Slowed, 75% for 9sec  Save: DC15 to negate slow  Charges: Using this item consumes one charge. This item is automatically discarded after all available charges are consumed. Items that have charges do not stack in inventory.  These devices allow a droid to create localized gravity swells, the reverse effect of a repulsorlift engine. This can seemingly increase the weight of an enemy, slowing their movement.

g_i_drdutldev005.name: Oil Slick
g_i_drdutldev005.description: This is a simple, yet effective, upgrade for any droid. A thin film of oil across the path of the enemy can slow their progress, allowing allies to retreat or engage them at range.

g_i_drdutldev003.name: Shield Disruptor
g_i_drdutldev003.description: Damage: Ion, 20pts  Range: Medium  Charges: Using this item consumes one charge. This item is automatically discarded after all available charges are consumed. Items that have charges do not stack in inventory.  Designed for Republic forces, these devices allow a droid to potentially devastate opponent droids or the personal shielding of an enemy, though the energy drain is quite large.

g_i_drdutldev001.name: Stun Ray
g_i_drdutldev001.description: Damage: None  On Hit: Stun, 100% for 9sec  Save: DC15 to negate stun  Range: Medium  Charges: Using this item consumes one charge. This item is automatically discarded after all available charges are consumed. Items that have charges do not stack in inventory.  Quellegh Industrial is becoming the standard in publicly traded non-lethal droid-mounted weapons. Company officials credit aggressive marketing towards any despot with credits.

g_w_firegren001.name: Plasma Grenade
g_w_firegren001.description: Damage: Heat, 36pts Area of Effect: 4m Range: Long Save: DC15 for half damage  These grenades release a quick burst of an incendiary agent that ignites immediately, damaging all enemies within the area of effect.

g_i_frarmbnds03.name: Arkanian Energy Shield
g_i_frarmbnds03.description: Deflection: Energy, Sonic, Cold, Heat, Electrical 40pts total  Duration: 200 seconds, or max damage taken  Charges: Using this item consumes one charge. This item is automatically discarded after all available charges are consumed. Items that have charges do not stack in inventory.  Even 2000 years after the designs were pioneered, Arkanian technology remains desirable. When equipped and activated, this forearm shield protects against a variety of combat conditions, though it must be replaced often due to burnout.

tar03_brejikband.name: Brejik's Arm Band
tar03_brejikband.description: Brejik's arm band, when used in conjunction with his belt, generates an effective barrier against melee attacks.

g_i_frarmbnds07.name: Echani Dueling Shield
g_i_frarmbnds07.description: Deflection: Energy, Electrical 60pts  Duration: 200 seconds, or max damage taken  Charges: Using this item consumes one charge. This item is automatically discarded after all available charges are consumed. Items that have charges do not stack in inventory.  Far more powerful than most forearm shields, when activated this unit absorbs some of the incoming energy to provide good protection without the need for bulky generators. The unit must still be replaced after repeated use, however.

g_i_frarmbnds04.name: Echani Shield
g_i_frarmbnds04.description: Deflection: Energy,Sonic, Electrical 50pts total  Duration: 200 seconds, or max damage taken  Charges: Using this item consumes one charge. This item is automatically discarded after all available charges are consumed. Items that have charges do not stack in inventory.  The Echani put much effort into developing a forearm shield that, once activated, would allow a mercenary to close on a blaster-wielding enemy relatively unscathed. This unit is discarded once its energy cells are depleted.

g_i_frarmbnds01.name: Energy Shield
g_i_frarmbnds01.description: Deflection: Energy, Electrical 20pts  Duration: 200 seconds, or max damage taken  Charges: Using this item consumes one charge. This item is automatically discarded after all available charges are consumed. Items that have charges do not stack in inventory.  When equipped and activated, these items project an energy shield around the wearer. The small power source can burn out when repeatedly stressed, requiring replacement of the entire unit.

g_i_frarmbnds05.name: Mandalorian Melee Shield
g_i_frarmbnds05.description: Deflection: Bludgeoning, Piercing, Slashing, 20pts total  Duration: 200 seconds, or max damage taken  Charges: Using this item consumes one charge. This item is automatically discarded after all available charges are consumed. Items that have charges do not stack in inventory.  Mandalorians don't fear melee combat, but anything that absorbs physical damage brings them a step closer to victory, and these forearm shields are a favorite. The units are discarded once their maximum activations have been expended.

g_i_frarmbnds06.name: Mandalorian Power Shield
g_i_frarmbnds06.description: Deflection: Energy, Bludgeoning, Piercing, Slashing, Electrical 30pts total  Duration: 200 seconds, or max damage taken  Charges: Using this item consumes one charge. This item is automatically discarded after all available charges are consumed. Items that have charges do not stack in inventory.  An improvement by the Mandalorians on their basic forearm shield, this variant proved decisive in several battles with the Republic. The units are discarded once their maximum number of activations have been expended.

g_i_frarmbnds02.name: Sith Energy Shield
g_i_frarmbnds02.description: Deflection: Energy, Sonic, Electrical 30pts total  Duration: 200 seconds, or max damage taken  Charges: Using this item consumes one charge. This item is automatically discarded after all available charges are consumed. Items that have charges do not stack in inventory.  The Sith have made many improvements to personal forearm shielding, much to the dismay of the Jedi. Though efficient, the unit must be replaced often as it burns out when repeatedly activated.

g_i_frarmbnds010.name: Verpine Prototype Shield
g_i_frarmbnds010.description: Deflection: Energy, Sonic, Cold, Heat, Electrical 70pts total  Duration: 200 seconds, or max damage taken  Charges: Using this item consumes one charge. This item is automatically discarded after all available charges are consumed. Items that have charges do not stack in inventory.  Though manufactured by the Verpine, these forearm shields are based on highly modified Arkanian designs. They are must-have items for the professional soldier, though they have to be replaced when the maximum number of activations are expended.

g_i_frarmbnds09.name: Verpine Prototype Shield
g_i_frarmbnds09.description: Deflection: Energy, Sonic, Cold, Heat, Electrical 70pts total  Duration: 200 seconds, or max damage taken  Charges: Using this item consumes one charge. This item is automatically discarded after all available charges are consumed. Items that have charges do not stack in inventory.  Though manufactured by the Verpine, these forearm shields are based on highly modified Arkanian designs. They are must-have items for the professional soldier, though they have to be replaced when the maximum number of activations are expended.

g_i_frarmbnds08.name: Yusanis' Dueling Shield
g_i_frarmbnds08.description: Deflection: Energy, Electrical 100pts  Duration: 200 seconds, or max damage taken  Charges: Using this item consumes one charge. This item is automatically discarded after all available charges are consumed. Items that have charges do not stack in inventory.  Yusanis sponsored many of the advances the Echani people are known for. Produced in his honor, these forearm shields are unmatched on the battlefield. The unit must be replaced when the maximum number of activations is depleted.

g_w_fraggren01.name: Frag Grenade
g_w_fraggren01.description: Damage: Piercing, 20pts Area of Effect: 4 meters Range: Long Save : DC15 for half damage  Fragmentation grenades are very basic. They explode when thrown, showering the enemy in shrapnel. It's not elegant, but it's definitely effective.

g_w_waraxe001.name: Gamorrean Battleaxe
g_w_waraxe001.description: Gamorrean Battleaxes, much like their namesake species, are heavy, unsubtle, and generally a very damaging influence in almost any situation.

g_w_waraxe002.name: Gamorrean Battleaxe
g_w_waraxe002.description: Gamorrean Battleaxes, much like their namesake species, are heavy, unsubtle, and generally a very damaging influence in almost any situation.

g1_i_gauntlet01.name: Advanced Stabilizer Gloves
g1_i_gauntlet01.description: These gloves contain an advanced fire control and trajectory analysis system which links to held ranged weapons. This allows the user greater accuracy when aiming their own weapons, and also gives warning when incoming fire would likely hit the wearer.

g_i_gauntlet05.name: Bothan "Machinist" Gloves
g_i_gauntlet05.description: This item uses microbursts of counter-current energy to calm unsteady nerves, increasing accuracy in the handling of volatile materials. The user must have basic knowledge of Demolitions (paid points into the skill) to benefit from this item.

tar03_brejikglov.name: Brejik's Gloves
tar03_brejikglov.description: Brejik's gloves are designed to enhance the hand/eye coordination of the wearer.

g_i_gauntlet07.name: Dominator Gauntlets
g_i_gauntlet07.description: A working proto-type of a huge technological advancement in power gauntlets, the Dominators give the user unparalleled strength and power.

g_i_gauntlet02.name: Eriadu Strength Amplifier
g_i_gauntlet02.description: This device uses micro-bursts of repulsorlift energy to assist actions in combat, giving the appearance that the user is stronger than normal.

geno_gloves.name: GenoHaradan Power Gloves
geno_gloves.description: Modeled on the Eriadu designs, these gloves use bursts of repulsor-lift energy to assist movement, effectively giving the wearer tremendous strength.

g_i_gauntlet09.name: Infiltrator Gloves
g_i_gauntlet09.description: These gloves are equipped with an advanced artifical intelligence unit that the wearer can use to tap into nearby computer systems through cables or wireless transmission. The system also stabilizes the wearer's hands for fine detail work.

g_i_gauntlet08.name: Karakan Gauntlets
g_i_gauntlet08.description: These heavy gauntlets, created by the isolationist Karakan, are almost a complete medical computer in themselves. They constantly monitor and adjust the nervous impulses, blood pressure, and tension through the wearers hands. The resulting increase in stability and overall system integrity have many benefits.

kor38a_gauntlet.name: Marka Ragnos' Gauntlets
kor38a_gauntlet.description: Ancient but still intact, these gloves appear to be made of black scales; they pulse with a dark power.

g_i_gauntlet03.name: Sith Power Gauntlets
g_i_gauntlet03.description: Based on stolen Eriadu designs, items of this type utilize almost uncomfortable bursts of repulsorlift energy to assist movement. They are rarely seen outside of Sith possession.

g_i_gauntlet04.name: Stabilizer Gauntlets
g_i_gauntlet04.description: These gauntlets are quite stiff, minimizing actions that might interfere with the manipulation of volatile materials. The user must have basic knowledge of Demolitions (paid points into the skill) to benefit from this item.

g_i_gauntlet01.name: Strength Gauntlets
g_i_gauntlet01.description: Developed by the Mephilis Corporation, these gauntlets use pulses of energy to stimulate muscles at the key leverage points of combat actions, effectively increasing strength.

g_i_gauntlet06.name: Verpine Bond Gauntlets
g_i_gauntlet06.description: Tensor-mesh stiffens the forearm for steady handling of volatile materials. The insect-like Verpine don't personally use these items, claiming they merely mimic their own exoskeletons. The user must have basic knowledge of Demolitions (paid points into the skill) to benefit from this item.

tat20_gaffichief.name: Chieftain's Gaffi Stick
tat20_gaffichief.description: A variation of the traditional gaffi stick, or gaderffii, marked as a chieftain's weapon by its slightly more ornate appearance and better construction.

g_w_gaffi001.name: Gaffi Stick
g_w_gaffi001.description: The gaffi stick, or gaderffii, is the traditional melee weapon of the Sand People. Crafted out of whatever salvage is at hand, they can be very effective in close combat.

tat20_gaffi02.name: Gaffi Stick
tat20_gaffi02.description: The gaffi stick, or gaderffii, is the traditional melee weapon of the Sand People. Crafted out of whatever salvage is at hand, they can be very effective in close combat.

tat20_gaffistick.name: Gaffi Stick
tat20_gaffistick.description: The gaffi stick, or gaderffii, is the traditional melee weapon of the Sand People. Crafted out of whatever salvage is at hand, they can be very effective in close combat.

g_w_qtrstaff03.name: Raito's Gaderffii
g_w_qtrstaff03.description: This may have belonged to a Sand People warrior famous among his kind for killing a young Jedi, but the one tribe that kept the oral history of this event was wiped out long ago.

g_i_glowrod01.name: Glow Rod
g_i_glowrod01.description: This is a cheap, handheld light source of limited range.

g_w_hvyblstr02.name: Arkanian Heavy Pistol
g_w_hvyblstr02.description: Arkanian designs of this kind predated mass acceptance of heavier pistols, but 2000 years later they are still superior performers.

g_w_hvyblstr05.name: Cassus Fett's Heavy Pistol
g_w_hvyblstr05.stat_modifiers: AttackBonus +1; AttackBonus +1; Damage; Damage; Enhancement +3; Keen; OnHit +10
g_w_hvyblstr05.description: Special: Upgradeable, Ranged  Cassus Fett was rarely seen without this adaptable blaster. Famous for killing the captain of a flagship Republic frigate at the Battle of Jaga's Cluster, he is presumed dead.

g_w_hvyblstr06.name: Cassus Fett's Heavy Pistol
g_w_hvyblstr06.stat_modifiers: AttackBonus +5; Damage; Damage; OnHit +10; Use_Limitation_Feat; Use_Limitation_Feat
g_w_hvyblstr06.description: Special: Upgradeable, Ranged  Cassus Fett was rarely seen without this adaptable blaster. Famous for killing the captain of a flagship Republic frigate at the Battle of Jaga's Cluster, he is presumed dead.

g_w_hvyblstr07.name: Cassus Fett's Heavy Pistol
g_w_hvyblstr07.stat_modifiers: Damage; Enhancement +5; OnHit +10; Use_Limitation_Feat; Use_Limitation_Feat; Use_Limitation_Feat
g_w_hvyblstr07.description: Special: Upgradeable, Ranged  Cassus Fett was rarely seen without this adaptable blaster. Famous for killing the captain of a flagship Republic frigate at the Battle of Jaga's Cluster, he is presumed dead.

g_w_hvyblstr08.name: Cassus Fett's Heavy Pistol
g_w_hvyblstr08.stat_modifiers: Damage; Enhancement +5; OnHit +10; Use_Limitation_Feat; Use_Limitation_Feat; Use_Limitation_Feat
g_w_hvyblstr08.description: Special: Upgradeable, Ranged  Cassus Fett was rarely seen without this adaptable blaster. Famous for killing the captain of a flagship Republic frigate at the Battle of Jaga's Cluster, he is presumed dead.

g_w_hvyblstr09.name: Cassus Fett's Heavy Pistol
g_w_hvyblstr09.stat_modifiers: Damage; Enhancement +5; Massive_Criticals; OnHit +10; Use_Limitation_Feat; Use_Limitation_Feat; Use_Limitation_Feat; Use_Limitation_Feat
g_w_hvyblstr09.description: Special: Upgradeable, Ranged  Cassus Fett was rarely seen without this adaptable blaster. Famous for killing the captain of a flagship Republic frigate at the Battle of Jaga's Cluster, he is presumed dead.

g_w_hvyblstr01.name: Heavy Blaster
g_w_hvyblstr01.description: These resemble regular blasters in the same way Quoorian marshsuckers resemble mosquitoes. Sure, they both do damage, but the former definitely has the edge in kill-potential.

g_w_hvyblstr04.name: Mandalorian Heavy Pistol
g_w_hvyblstr04.description: Mandalorians boast that a shot from one of these pistols can take a starship out of commission. It's an obvious exaggeration, but for safety's sake, most listeners just smile and nod.

g_w_hvyblstr03.name: Zabrak Tystel Mark III
g_w_hvyblstr03.description: The Zabrak killed many pirates who were attempting to seize shipments of these weapons and then sold them on the black market anyway. It's not a matter of where they end up, but of who gets paid.

g1_w_hvrptbltr01.name: Baragwin Heavy Repeating Blaster
g1_w_hvrptbltr01.stat_modifiers: AttackBonus +1; AttackBonus +1; AttackBonus +1; Damage; Damage; Damage; Damage; Damage
g1_w_hvrptbltr01.description: Special: Upgradeable, Ranged  A heavier version of the Baragwin Assault Gun, this weapon features similar improvements over its more common version. The incredible amounts of energy contained in the beam can be upgraded even further to produce a blast capable of setting even durasteel on fire for brief periods.

g_w_hvrptbltr01.name: Heavy Repeating Blaster
g_w_hvrptbltr01.description: This weapon again increases the firepower available to the foot soldier or mercenary, but it is not for the lightly armored who wish to be quick on their feet.

g_w_hvrptbltr02.name: Mandalorian Heavy Repeater
g_w_hvrptbltr02.description: With this weapon, the Mandalorians again demonstrate a complete lack of subtlety. The only thing better than a big blaster, apparently, is one that shoots faster.

g_w_hvrptbltr002.name: Ordo's Repeating Blaster
g_w_hvrptbltr002.description: Special: Upgradeable, Ranged  This prototype heavy repeater was developed during the latter part of the Mandalorian War and never saw general production.

g_w_hldoblstr04.name: Bothan Needler
g_w_hldoblstr04.description: For serious espionage, this is the weapon of choice. Simple ownership can get you arrested in some systems, or invited to dine with royalty, depending on what it helped you learn.

g_w_hldoblstr003.name: Bothan Quick Draw
g_w_hldoblstr003.description: An unconscious opponent is a quiet opponent. This weapon is a Bothan favorite, designed to "create opportunities."

g_w_hldoblstr02.name: Bothan Quick Draw
g_w_hldoblstr02.description: An unconscious opponent is a quiet opponent. This weapon is a Bothan favorite, designed to "create opportunities."

g_w_hldoblstr01.name: Hold Out Blaster
g_w_hldoblstr01.description: Sometimes called a "sleeper," the hold out blaster is the preferred method of temporarily incapacitating an enemy.

g_w_hldoblstr004.name: Sith Assassin Pistol
g_w_hldoblstr004.description: These weapons are designed to incapacitate so death may be quick or lingered upon as desired. Droids are simply dispatched, as cruelty is best rationed among the living.

g_w_hldoblstr03.name: Sith Assassin Pistol
g_w_hldoblstr03.description: These weapons are designed to incapacitate so death may be quick or lingered upon as desired. Droids are simply dispatched, as cruelty is best rationed among the living.

g_i_implant101.name: Cardio Package
g_i_implant101.description: This implant micromanages the cardiovascular system, effectively increasing the user's constitution faster and further than hard work and exercise might.

g_i_implant104.name: Done
g_i_implant104.description: This implant releases synthetic versions of the natural stimulants produced by the body, temporarily boosting the user's stamina.

g_i_implant103.name: Memory Package
g_i_implant103.description: This implant stimulates the brain, effectively increasing the user's capacity for intelligent thought, all at a price cheaper than a trip to the libraries of Coruscant.

g_i_implant102.name: Response Package
g_i_implant102.description: This implant boosts the regular energy impulses of the nervous system, sharpening the performance of dexterous action. Inactive users may suffer the odd lingering twitch.

g_i_implant201.name: Biotech Package
g_i_implant201.description: This implant does use relatively experimental nano-technology to speed healing, but relies more on coagulants and solid doses of pain relievers. If you feel better, you are better.

g_i_implant204.name: I need to make the party selections screen available
g_i_implant204.description: This implant bolsters the immune system, prompting it to react immediately aggressively toward any virus or bacterium that might have otherwise resulted in a debilitating sickness.

g_i_implant203.name: Nerve Enhancement Package
g_i_implant203.description: This implant regulates the nervous system, preventing loss of consciousness due to sudden impact or sensory overload.

g_i_implant202.name: Retinal Combat Implant
g_i_implant202.description: This ocular implant greatly increases visual acuity, allowing the user to better track enemy movement in combat. General awareness will improve as well.

g1_i_implant304.name: Advanced Alacrity Impant
g1_i_implant304.description: By fine-tuning the user's nervous system, this implant allows vastly improved reaction times and coordination over unmodified individuals. The success of this implant, though not in wide distribution due to its cost, has prompted some at rival Bavakar Medical Research Labs to call for it to be banned.

g1_i_implant302.name: Advanced Bio-Stabilizer Implant
g1_i_implant302.description: This detailed micro-computer analyzes the contents of the user's circulatory system, as well as surges and drops in nerve transmission rates. It attempts to stabilize the user's system, and remove undesirable elements from it.

g1_i_implant303.name: Advanced Combat Implant
g1_i_implant303.stat_modifiers: BonusFeats; BonusFeats; BonusFeats; BonusFeats; BonusFeats; BonusFeats; BonusFeats; BonusFeats; BonusFeats; BonusFeats; BonusFeats; BonusFeats
g1_i_implant303.description: The Advanced Combat Implant is an experimental technology, designed to make computer data available to the user. Naturally, one of the first uses for this technology was combat. This implant contains weapons specification, and advanced usage techniques for all known weaponry in the Republic and associated territories.

g1_i_implant301.name: Advanced Sensory Implant
g1_i_implant301.description: By assisting the areas of the user's brain dedicated to sensory-interpretation, this implant greatly heightens the user's awareness of their surroundings, as well as spatial perception and analysis.

g_i_implant301.name: Bavakar Cardio Package
g_i_implant301.description: This implant stimulates cardiovascular performance well beyond the user's norm. The Bavakar Medical Research Labs are at the forefront of developmental cybernetics.

g_i_implant303.name: Bavakar Memory Chip
g_i_implant303.description: This implant controls a cocktail of synthetic nutrients, encouraging quick thought in the user. The Bavakar Medical Research Labs are at the forefront of developmental cybernetics.

g_i_implant302.name: Bavakar Reflex Enhancement
g_i_implant302.description: Stimulants and energy bursts allow this implant to boost a user's reflexes well beyond normal. The Bavakar Medical Research Labs are at the forefront of developmental cybernetics.

g_i_implant309.name: Beemon Package
g_i_implant309.description: Beemon's top of the line package usurps the body's natural reactions to stress and damage, allowing the user to withstand greater amounts of punishment and exertion than normally possible.

g_i_implant304.name: Bio-Antidote Package
g_i_implant304.description: This implant maintains an ever-circulating stream of antitoxins in the user, increasing relevant antidotes for specific poisons introduced. Side effects include dry mouth.

g_i_implant305.name: Cardio Power System
g_i_implant305.description: This implant increases the cardio-vascular recovery rate and pain tolerance of the wearer, giving them almost supernatural stamina.

g_i_implant310.name: Cyber Reaction System
g_i_implant310.description: This system supplants the user's normal nervous system, enhancing it artificially. It allows the impluses to travel faster and farther along the system, improving reaction time, while also improving fine motor control, increasing accuracy.

g_i_implant306.name: Gordulan Reaction System
g_i_implant306.description: This implant hyper-stimulates the nervous system of the wearer, significantly improving both reaction time and hand-eye coordination.

g_i_implant307.name: Navardan Regenerator
g_i_implant307.description: This implant gives incredible healing powers, allowing wounds and injuries to heal in mere seconds instead of days or weeks.

g_i_implant308.name: Sith Regenerator
g_i_implant308.description: Extensively used by Sith intelligence operatives, this implant stimulate cell replication in the user's body, allowing wounds to be healed quickly and easily. It is most frequently used on operatives operating behind enemy lines for extended periods, where medical treatment is not normally available.

g_w_ionblstr01.name: Ion Blaster
g_w_ionblstr01.description: Unlike a typical blaster, this weapon fires a stream of energy very damaging to electrical systems, causing havoc on the internal components of droids.

g_w_ionblstr02.name: Verpine Prototype Ion Blaster
g_w_ionblstr02.description: Demonstrating this weapon, the insect-like Verpine destroyed legions of droids, doing nothing to quell the public's suspicions of what testing their stun guns must have been like.

g_w_iongren01.name: Ion Grenade
g_w_iongren01.description: Damage: Ion, 15pts (45pts vs. droids) Area of Effect: 4m Range: Long Save: DC15 for half damage  These grenades emit an extremely strong burst of energy devastating to any droids or personal shields caught in the effect.

g1_w_ionrfl01.description: Special: Upgradeable, Ranged  This weapon is an experimental Baragwin design that has been extensively modified by Suvam Tan. He has incorporated what he describes as a 'shaped-energy' delivery system into the weapon, which allows it to deliver concussive force on impact in addition to the weapon's normal energy discharge. Upgrades to the weapon could potentially greatly increase both its impact force and its penetration.

g_w_ionrfl02.name: Bothan Droid Disruptor
g_w_ionrfl02.description: Droids can be difficult obstacles for a spy, but these weapons take all the guesswork out of dealing with them.

g_w_ionrfl01.name: Ion Rifle
g_w_ionrfl01.description: Any well-stocked militia usually has stores of ion rifles in reserve. They aren't much use against the living, but if the enemy has battle droids these weapons become essential.

g_w_ionrfl03.name: Verpine Droid Disruptor
g_w_ionrfl03.description: While they may have borrowed liberally from designs the Bothans initiated, the Verpine say you can't argue with results. These weapons are simply devastating against droids.

g_a_jedirobe007.name: Qel-Droma Robes
g_a_jedirobe007.description: The Force is strong in the Qel-Droma blood, and many of the family have joined the Jedi Order over the centuries. These robes were created as a gift for Cay Qel-Droma during the war against Exar Kun, and it is said that only one who truly walks the path of the light can wear them. Cay himself wore the robes in his duel against Ulic Qel-Droma, his brother who had fallen to the dark side. Cay was slain in the battle, but his death at his brother's hand eventual lead to Ulic's redemption. These powerful robes then passed down to Duron Qel-Droma, Cay's cousin, when he joined the Jedi. k39_itm_cersaber.name: Sith Lightsaber
k39_itm_cersaber.description: This lightsaber is quite intricate in its design, the hilt covered in delicate runes and inlaid with black markings. No doubt the purpose of the weapon is primarily ceremonial, though it certainly seems to perform as a lightsaber should.

g_w_sbrcrstl015.description: Special: Upgrade Item, Lightsaber  Blade Color: Blue  A facetted crystal used in the constructing of a lightsaber. It glows faintly with an inner blue light.

g_w_sbrcrstl14.description: Special: Upgrade Item, Lightsaber  Blade Color: Blue  A facetted crystal used in the constructing of a lightsaber. It glows faintly with an inner blue light.

g_w_sbrcrstl11.name: Crystal, Bondar
g_w_sbrcrstl11.description: Special: Upgrade Item, Lightsaber  This crystal was mined on a far-orbit asteroid circling the Alderaan system. It produces a volatile lightsaber beam that pulses on impact, discharging part of its energy into an opponent.

g_w_sbrcrstl02.name: Crystal, Damind
g_w_sbrcrstl02.description: Special: Upgrade Item, Lightsaber  Found on the desert world of Daminia, this crystal can be used in lightsaber construction to produce a clearly defined beam of subtly wider width and length.

g_w_sbrcrstl03.name: Crystal, Eralam
g_w_sbrcrstl03.description: Special: Upgrade Item, Lightsaber  Once mined on the third moon of Erai, ancient Sith bombardment shattered much that remained. If they can be found, these crystals produce a clear, superior lightsaber beam.

g_w_sbrcrstl10.name: Crystal, Firkrann
g_w_sbrcrstl10.description: Special: Upgrade Item, Lightsaber  This heavy crystal is collected by the natives of Rafa V. If used in lightsaber construction it produces an electrically charged beam that is much easier to manipulate than standard beams.

g_w_sbrcrstl16.name: Crystal, Green
g_w_sbrcrstl16.description: Special: Upgrade Item, Lightsaber  Blade Color: Green  A facetted crystal used in the constructing of a lightsaber. It glows faintly with an inner green light.

g_w_sbrcrstl07.name: Crystal, Jenruax
g_w_sbrcrstl07.description: Special: Upgrade Item, Lightsaber  The refined form of Opila, this crystal has been cleansed of all impurities. When used in lightsaber construction it produces a blade of unerring quickness.

g_w_sbrcrstl09.name: Crystal, Luxum
g_w_sbrcrstl09.description: Special: Upgrade Item, Lightsaber  Ambria was a world in the grip of the dark side. Through years of mental battle, strange Jedi Master Thon contained the evil to Lake Natth. Long meditation can form this powerful crystal from the tainted water.

g_w_sbrcrstl05.name: Crystal, Nextor
g_w_sbrcrstl05.description: Special: Upgrade Item, Lightsaber  This crystal is mined in the mountains of planet M'haeli, and when used in lightsaber construction it produces a volatile blade that can cause surprising amounts of damage.

g_w_sbrcrstl06.name: Crystal, Opila
g_w_sbrcrstl06.description: Special: Upgrade Item, Lightsaber  Found in the asteroid fields of the Fyrth system, this crystal can be used in lightsaber construction to produce an intense beam that seems extraordinarily quick to the cut.

g_w_sbrcrstl08.name: Crystal, Phond
g_w_sbrcrstl08.description: Special: Upgrade Item, Lightsaber   The strange byproduct of rare impurities bonding during the making of certain alloys and some random external condition, this crystal produces a fiercely burning lightsaber beam.

g_w_sbrcrstl18.name: Crystal, Red
g_w_sbrcrstl18.description: Special: Upgrade Item, Lightsaber  Blade Color: Red  A facetted crystal used in the constructing of a lightsaber. It glows faintly with an inner red light.

g_w_sbrcrstl01.name: Crystal, Rubat
g_w_sbrcrstl01.description: Special: Upgrade Item, Lightsaber  Used in lightsaber construction, rubat crystal is mined on Phemis. It produces a clearly defined blade that a Jedi can easily focus on.

g_w_sbrcrstl04.name: Crystal, Sapith
g_w_sbrcrstl04.description: Special: Upgrade Item, Lightsaber  This crystallized material was excreted once every 11 years by the ancient Volice worm of Lwhekk, now extinct. It produces a more intense lightsaber beam, granting better control.

g_w_sbrcrstl12.name: Crystal, Sigil
g_w_sbrcrstl12.description: Special: Upgrade Item, Lightsaber  Mined in the Sigil System, this crystal is a costly but valued addition to a lightsaber. It produces a fiercely bright beam that sears on contact, inflicting great damage.

g_w_sbrcrstl19.name: Crystal, Solari
g_w_sbrcrstl19.description: Special: Upgrade Item, Lightsaber  There are many famous lightsaber crystals spoken of in the history of the Jedi Order, though few are as powerful as the legendary Solari Crystal. An artifact of true light side power, only those Jedi who are pure in spirit can wield a lightsaber equipped with this gleaming white gem. When the great Jedi Master Ood Bnar initiated his life-cycle change after a thousand years of serving the Order, he bequeathed the Solari Crystal to his most promising student, a young female Jedi named Shaela Nuur. When Shaela disappeared shortly after the time of the Great Hunt, the Solari Crystal vanished with her.

g_w_sbrcrstl13.name: Crystal, Upari
g_w_sbrcrstl13.description: Special: Upgrade Item, Lightsaber  Strangely, this crystal is usually encountered scattered in the orbit of primarily forest worlds. It is brittle but versatile, and a Master Jedi can get it to produce many effects.

g_w_sbrcrstl17.name: Crystal, Violet
g_w_sbrcrstl17.description: Special: Upgrade Item, Lightsaber  Blade Color: Violet  A facetted crystal used in the constructing of a lightsaber. It glows faintly with an inner violet light.

g_w_sbrcrstl15.name: Crystal, Yellow

g1_w_sbrcrstl20.name: Heart of the Guardian
g1_w_sbrcrstl20.description: Special: Upgrade Item, Lightsaber  Though its origins have been lost, the legendary artifact known as the Heart of the Guardian was rumored to have been instrumental in the founding of the guardian order of Jedi. Nothing further is mentioned in any Jedi archive, but both Sith and Jedi whisper their own legends. According to the Jedi, the Heart will appear in a time of greatest turmoil and deliver the galaxy into salvation. The Sith, however, believe it to be an object of their heritage, which will bring the galaxy under their dominion.   The Heart of the Guardian appears to be a magnificently shaped lightsaber crystal of unknown composition. Analysis by Suvam Tan has yielded inconclusive results, not being able to identify what mineral it's made of. Suvam has even begun to wonder if it is a normal crystal at all, for at times it almost seems as if it were alive.  All known lightsaber crystals seem to have a strange resonance with the Heart of the Guardian, their properties being altered or enhanced when in close proximity to it. Additionally, energy focused through the Heart results in a beam of unique clarity and color.

dan13_bluecryst.description: Special: Upgrade Item, Lightsaber  Blade Color: Blue  A facetted crystal used in the constructing of a lightsaber. It glows faintly with an inner blue light.

dan13_grncryst.name: Lightsaber Crystal, Green
dan13_grncryst.description: Special: Upgrade Item, Lightsaber  Blade Color: Green  A facetted crystal used in the constructing of a lightsaber. It glows faintly with an inner green light.

dan13_goldcryst.name: Lightsaber Crystal, Yellow

g1_w_sbrcrstl21.name: Mantle of the Force
g1_w_sbrcrstl21.description: Special: Upgrade Item, Lightsaber  The Mantle of the Force is an item assembled by Suvam Tan from pieces found in the ruins of Exar Kun's temples on the fourth moon orbiting Yavin. It appears to be the remains of an even older artifact of unknown origin. It is not known if it was used by Exar Kun, or just uncovered when his temples were destroyed. Nor is it known what the original properties of the item were, but given the current abilities, in its original state it must have been fearsome indeed.  The Mantle is a crystalline lattice, resembling a lightsaber crystal in many ways, but having the additional property of being able to radically alter the flow of energy that passes through it. When combined with other crystals, the Mantle warps their properties, often enhancing them to incredible levels.  Additionally, the Mantle seems to almost act as a focusing tool for Force-sensitive individuals, leading to the idea that the original artifact may once have been a powerful tool of the Sith, or perhaps something they took with them when the dark Jedi originally split from the Order.

kas25_wookcrysta.description: Special: Upgrade Item, Lightsaber  Although as jewelry it is merely decorative, the crystal in this Wookiee hunting clan amulet looks similar to those used in lightsaber construction and may have interesting properties.

g_w_lngswrd02.description: Twisted by the dark side, the Krath tempered swords with the power of the Force perhaps even before lightsabers became the weapon of the Jedi, both dark and light.

k37_itm_freednf1.name: Silver Lined Sword
k37_itm_freednf1.description: This blade is long and straight and sparkles with a silver glow that becomes brighter as the hilt is touched. It is quite warm, and it almost appears that the blade becomes white-hot once it is equipped. Such a fiery weapon would be devastating against an unarmored opponent. A small insignia of a flame is impressed upon the hilt.

g1_i_mask03.name: Advanced Agent Interface
g1_i_mask03.stat_modifiers: Use_Limitation_Feat; Skill +7; Skill +7; Skill +7; Skill +7; Skill +7
g1_i_mask03.description: A visor with an integrated computer and electronics analysis system, the Advanced Agent Interface uses a superior artificial intelligence routine to assist the wearer in all manner of covert and computer-oriented tasks. It can also be used to connect to a secure computer via physical cables, enabling the AI to act on its own to breach that system.

g_i_mask09.name: Advanced Aural Amplifier
g_i_mask09.description: Restricted: not useable by Wookiees  In a fine balancing act, this unit amplifies the faint sounds of moving creatures, while filtering out louder background noise that might otherwise deafen the user.

g1_i_mask01.name: Advanced Bio-Stabilizer Mask
g1_i_mask01.description: Similar to the Advanced Bio-Stabilizer Implant, this mask analyzes circulation patterns through the skin, monitors breathing through chemical sensors, and reactions through eye movements. It additionally acts as a nearly complete environmental system, preventing toxins from ever reaching the wearer.

g_band.name: Ancient Rakatan Band
g_band.stat_modifiers: BonusFeats; BonusFeats; BonusFeats; DamageResist; DamageResist; ImprovedSavingThrows +5
g_band.description: Some sort of ancient Rakatan band that fits over the wearer's head. You can feel the power emanating from this item.

g_i_mask009.name: Aural Amplifier
g_i_mask009.description: Restricted: not useable by Wookiees  With this item, Durkish Corporation abandoned visual detection in favor of aural, citing that most creatures breathe, and even camouflage fields can't blend the sound of that away.

g_i_mask08.name: Aural Amplifier
g_i_mask08.description: Restricted: not useable by Wookiees  With this item, Durkish Corporation abandoned visual detection in favor of aural, citing that most creatures breathe, and even camouflage fields can't blend the sound of that away.

g_i_mask03.name: Bothan Perception Visor
g_i_mask03.description: Restricted: not useable by Wookiees  Bothans treat information like any other resource, and invest a great deal in devices that help collect it. These Bothan visors are considered to be among the best in the galaxy.

g_i_mask05.name: Bothan Sensory Visor
g_i_mask05.description: Restricted: not useable by Wookiees  Bothans place great importance on the tools of the information trade. They would consider these items to be of average quality, though their standards are exceptionally high.

g_i_mask12.name: Breath Mask
g_i_mask12.description: Restricted: not useable by Wookiees  This is standard issue gear for Republic forces and most professional soldiers, protecting against a variety of gas-based attacks.

g_i_mask023.name: Circlet of Saresh
g_i_mask023.description: Restricted: not useable by Wookiees  The wealthy Saresh family of Taris were once known as much for their arrogance and cruelty as for their vast riches and political power. But over the last century many of the family have shown a strong affinity to the Force, and been taken in by the Jedi for training. Foremost among these was Guun Han Saresh, heir to the family fortune. To celebrate Guun Han's acceptance into the Order, his father commissioned the crafting of a powerful headband: the Circlet of Saresh. To prevent this spectacular gift from leading his son down the path of arrogance and pride - an all too real possibility given the Saresh family history - the circlet was fashioned so that only one who is a true servant of the light can use it. The circlet was in Gunn Han's possession when he disappeared shortly after the time of the Great Hunt.

g_i_mask22.name: Circlet of Saresh
g_i_mask22.description: Restricted: not useable by Wookiees  The wealthy Saresh family of Taris were once known as much for their arrogance and cruelty as for their vast riches and political power. But over the last century many of the family have shown a strong affinity to the Force, and been taken in by the Jedi for training. Foremost among these was Guun Han Saresh, heir to the family fortune. To celebrate Guun Han's acceptance into the Order, his father commissioned the crafting of a powerful headband: the Circlet of Saresh. To prevent this spectacular gift from leading his son down the path of arrogance and pride - an all too real possibility given the Saresh family history - the circlet was fashioned so that only one who is a true servant of the light can use it. The circlet was in Gunn Han's possession when he disappeared shortly after the time of the Great Hunt.

g_i_mask18.name: Combat Sensor
g_i_mask18.description: Restricted: not useable by Wookiees  The targeting software inherent in this visor uses predictive algorithms to direct the wearer's gaze, allowing them to function more efficiently in combat.

tar08_davikmask.name: Davik's Visor
tar08_davikmask.description: Davik's visor is designed to enhance the user's ability to target and deal damage when using a blaster.

g_i_mask17.name: Demolitions Sensor
g_i_mask17.description: Restricted: not useable by Wookiees  This item uses advanced processors to assist the wearer in the visual analysis of microelectronics commonly used in demolitions. The acuity granted also serves to improve general awareness.

geno_visor.name: GenoHaradan Visor
geno_visor.description: Restricted: not useable by Wookiees  These visors hone a Genoharadan agent's senses, making them virtually impossible to catch unaware. The enhanced awareness also increases the agent's effectiveness in combat and in setting delicate, complex explosives.

g_i_mask24.name: Heavy Targetting Optics
g_i_mask24.description: This advanced optics and targetting system, worn as a mask, attaches to a held weapon, in this case rifles and heavy weapons, and provides targetting information, distances, and tracking of potential targets within line of sight.

g_i_mask16.name: Interface Band
g_i_mask16.description: Restricted: not useable by Wookiees  This item provides a mental interface to a store of information on electronic systems common to security, demolitions, and general computing functions.

g_i_mask21.name: Interface Visor
g_i_mask21.description: Restricted: not useable by Wookiees  This visor combines mental and visual interfaces to aid in the analysis of electronic systems common to security, demolitions, and general computing functions.

g_i_mask01.name: Light-Scan Visor
g_i_mask01.description: Restricted: not useable by Wookiees  These are invaluable tools that increase visual acuity by analyzing light on several frequencies above those of normal sight.

g1_i_mask02.name: Medical Interface Visor
g1_i_mask02.description: Similar in functionality to the Bio-Stabilizer series of medical equipment, this visor is designed to assist in the care and treatment of injured individuals. By providing constant data and analysis on the condition of the patient, this visor greatly increases the chance of survival of even the most critically injured of patients.

g_i_mask02.name: Motion Detection Goggles
g_i_mask02.description: Restricted: not useable by Wookiees  A built-in micro tracking processor means a user wearing these goggles can detect almost any movement.

g_i_mask10.name: Neural Band
g_i_mask10.description: Restricted: not useable by Wookiees  Developed after the Exar Kun war, this item bolsters the willpower of the user by electrically reinforcing established mental patterns. Republic troops called it "Little Shocky".

g_i_mask23.name: Pistol Targetting Optics
g_i_mask23.description: This advanced optics and targetting system, worn as a mask, attaches to a held weapon, in this case pistol, and provides targetting information, distances, and tracking of potential targets within line of sight.

g_i_mask14.name: Sith Mask
g_i_mask14.description: This mask blocks outside mental influence and other sensory noise, allowing the user to focus their abilities inward with no distraction.

g_i_mask07.name: Sonic Nullifiers
g_i_mask07.description: Restricted: not useable by Wookiees  Replacing bulky ear protection, these items make use of newly developed counterwave-nullifiers, an innovation pioneered by shipyard workers, not the military.

g_i_mask15.name: Stabilizer Mask
g_i_mask15.description: Restricted: not useable by Wookiees  This mask uses micro-bursts of electricity to regulate the user's mental patterns. It effectively fortifies both mind and body against attack.

g_i_mask19.name: Stealth Field Enhancer
g_i_mask19.description: Restricted: not useable by Wookiees  A specialized espionage unit designed to get the most out of a stealth field generator by improving the user's perception of the field while in Stealth Mode.

g_i_mask20.name: Stealth Field Reinforcement
g_i_mask20.description: Restricted: not useable by Wookiees  A very powerful item designed to both regulate stealth field emissions and improve the user's perception of the field while in Stealth Mode.

g_i_mask13.name: Teta's Royal Band
g_i_mask13.description: Restricted: not useable by Wookiees  This "royal band" is attributed to Empress Teta, a warrior leader of Cinnagar. She was instrumental in defeating the Sith in the Great Hyperspace War over a thousand years ago.

kor38b_mask.name: Tulak Hord's Mask
kor38b_mask.description: This ancient mask, blackened with age, has an eerie glow and seems uncomfortably claustrophobic.

g_i_mask06.name: Vacuum Mask
g_i_mask06.description: Restricted: not useable by Wookiees  Intersystem travel is commonplace, but the inherent dangers should not be forgotten, especially in times of war. Many consider these to be essential equipment for spacefarers.

g_i_mask11.name: Verpine Headband
g_i_mask11.description: Restricted: not useable by Wookiees  Not subject to Republic regulations, the Verpine increased neural band effectiveness with brute electrical force. The market is there, but long-term effects on users are unknown.

g_i_mask04.name: Verpine Ocular Enhancer
g_i_mask04.description: Restricted: not useable by Wookiees  The Verpine only manufacture this product for export, having no need of it themselves. They have highly evolved sight, a quality they smugly say the visors mimic but do not exceed.

g_i_medeqpmnt003.name: Advanced Medpac
g_i_medeqpmnt003.description: An advanced medpac contains an improved array of equipment for the treatment of wounds. They cannot be used by droids. Advanced medpacs heal 20 vitality points + (2 x user's skill in Treat Injury).

g_i_medeqpmnt02.name: Advanced Medpac
g_i_medeqpmnt02.description: An advanced medpac contains an improved array of equipment for the treatment of wounds. They cannot be used by droids. Advanced medpacs heal 20 vitality points + WIS modifier + (2 x user's skill in Treat Injury).

g_i_medeqpmnt06.name: Advanced Medpac
g_i_medeqpmnt06.description: An advanced medpac contains an improved array of equipment for the treatment of wounds. They cannot be used by droids. Advanced medpacs heal 20 vitality points + WIS modifier + (2 x user's skill in Treat Injury).

k_kor_koltadvmed.name: Advanced Medpac
k_kor_koltadvmed.description: An advanced medpac contains an improved array of equipment for the treatment of wounds. They cannot be used by droids. Advanced medpacs heal 20 vitality points + (2 x user's skill in Treat Injury).

g_i_medeqpmnt05.name: Antibiotic Kit
g_i_medeqpmnt05.description: This kit contains an array of hypospray injectors filled with a broad chemical mix that quickly overwhelms viral or bacterial infections, effectively curing most known diseases.

g_i_medeqpmnt04.name: Antidote Kit
g_i_medeqpmnt04.description: This kit contains wide-spectrum antidote hypospray injectors designed to neutralize all known poisons. Lowered attribute scores are returned to normal and physical damage is halted. Damage already suffered must still be healed by other means.

g_i_medeqpmnt03.name: Life Support Pack
g_i_medeqpmnt03.description: A life support pack contains dermal regenerators and other equipment for the treatment of wounds. They cannot be used by droids. Life support packs heal 30 vitality points + WIS modifier + (3 x user's skill in Treat Injury).

g_i_medeqpmnt07.name: Life Support Pack
g_i_medeqpmnt07.description: A life support pack contains dermal regenerators and other equipment for the treatment of wounds. They cannot be used by droids. Life support packs heal 30 vitality points + WIS modifier + (3 x user's skill in Treat Injury).

g_i_medeqpmnt002.name: Medpac
g_i_medeqpmnt002.description: A medpac contains essential equipment for the treatment of wounds. They cannot be used by droids. Basic medpacs heal 10 vitality points + user's skill in Treat Injury.

g_i_medeqpmnt01.name: Medpac
g_i_medeqpmnt01.description: A medpac contains essential equipment for the treatment of wounds. They cannot be used by droids. Basic medpacs heal 10 vitality points + WIS modifier + user's skill in Treat Injury.

k_kor_koltomed.description: A medpac contains essential equipment for the treatment of wounds. They cannot be used by droids. Basic medpacs heal 10 vitality points + user's skill in Treat Injury.
