g_i_pazsidebd001.name: Pazaak Side Deck
g_i_pazsidebd001.description: Pazaak requires both a main deck and a side deck. You can store all your side deck cards here and bring them out when you start a game.

ancienttome.name: Ancient Tome
ancienttome.description: This worn manuscript appears to be a collection of historical and religious writings from the height of the Infinite Empire's power. It includes details on a number of rituals sacred to the Rakata.

g_i_upgrade005.name: Armor Reinforcement
g_i_upgrade005.description: Special: Upgrade Item, Armor  Durasteel reinforcement is a complicated armor application that increases protective qualities. The modifications require a workbench with adequate tools and armor of high quality marked as upgradeable.

kas25_swordblade.name: Bacca's Sword Blade
kas25_swordblade.description: This is part of Bacca's Ceremonial Blade, damaged due to the arrogance of Chieftain Rothrrrawr. He underestimated a creature in the Shadowlands (later dubbed the Great Beast), and lost the blade in its hide. The hilt remained in his court, passed to other chieftains. If both pieces could be found, the sword might be able to be reassembled.

kas25_swordhilt.name: Bacca's sword hilt
kas25_swordhilt.description: This is the hilt of Bacca's Ceremonial Blade. The weapon was damaged due to the arrogance of Chieftain Rothrrrawr. He underestimated a creature in the Shadowlands (later dubbed the Great Beast), and lost the blade in its hide. The hilt remained in his court, passed to other chieftains.

tat20_banthafod.name: Bantha Fodder
tat20_banthafod.description: This is a highly pungent mixture of local plants and fungus. Banthas apparently find it irresistible, though it's doubtful any intelligent species would willingly call it food.

g_i_upgrade003.name: Beam Splitter
g_i_upgrade003.description: Special: Upgrade Item, Ranged  This item can broaden the beam of certain blaster types, increasing damage or possibly granting other effects. The modifications require a workbench with adequate tools and a weapon of high quality marked as upgradeable.

man28_chum.name: Body Parts
man28_chum.description: The mangled and bloody remains of humans, Twi'leks and less identifiable species.

kas24_bowcasbolt.name: Bowcaster Bolt Casing
kas24_bowcasbolt.description: This bolt casing was abandoned next to Rorworr's corpse, likely by whoever killed him. Bowcasters and the accompanying bolt casings are very personal items among the Wookiees, and are adorned with traditional family symbols and other identifying marks. It is possible the owner of this one could be identified by a knowledgeable Wookiee.

unk42_key.name: Cage Key
unk42_key.description: The is a key that appears to fit the cages in the Elder Researchers' room.

man28_toxic.name: Chemical Cannister
man28_toxic.description: A cannister containing a chemical toxic to firaxan sharks.

tar08_comppass.name: Computer Passcard
tar08_comppass.description: This seems to be a standard keycard for use at secure terminals.  Most likely, this one is designed to Davik's computer system.

kas22_resouceid.name: Czerka Corp. Resource ID
kas22_resouceid.description: This grants access to a Czerka resource station, which are usually deployed in areas where patrols may need emergency supplies. Most shut down if tampered with to minimize theft.

tat17_wraidplate.name: Desert Wraid Skull Plate
tat17_wraidplate.description: This is the incredibly dense bone skull plate cut from a desert wraid. They are rumored to have medical uses, but the market for them is very specific.

kas24_droidhead.name: Droid Head
kas24_droidhead.description: Replaying the last memory of this damaged droid reveals that it and its owners were the victims of an ambush by someone named Eli. The name "Matton" was also mentioned.

g_i_upgrade008.name: Durasteel Bonding Alloy
g_i_upgrade008.description: Special: Upgrade Item, Melee  Application of this alloy can strengthen a melee weapon, increasing damage and possibly resistance to damage. The modifications require a workbench with adequate tools and a weapon of high quality marked as upgradeable.

g_i_upgrade009.name: Energy Projector
g_i_upgrade009.description: Special: Upgrade Item, Melee  This modular projector can cause a melee weapon to do additional energy-based damage. The modifications require a workbench with adequate tools and a weapon of high quality marked as upgradeable.

man28_envirosuit.name: Envirosuit
man28_envirosuit.description: This is a variant of a standard model envirosuit used to protect its occupant from hostile environmental conditions. In this case it has been specifically modified to withstand tremendous undersea pressures.

tar10_garagekey.name: Garage Head Key Card
tar10_garagekey.description: This key card will give access to most of the restricted areas in the Vulkar garage.

g_i_gizkapois001.name: Gizka Poison
g_i_gizkapois001.description: Any gizka ingesting one of these toxic pellets will die within a few seconds. It will also cause the creature to attack all other gizka in the area, infecting them as well.

g_i_upgrade004.name: Hair Trigger
g_i_upgrade004.description: Special: Upgrade Item, Ranged  This unit regulates the firing mechanism of certain blaster types, improving the ability of a skilled user to fire rapidly. The modifications require a workbench with adequate tools and a weapon of high quality marked as upgradeable.

k36_itm_holocron.name: Holocron
k36_itm_holocron.description: This small crystal supposedly holds holographic recordings of the ancient Sith... information which could be incredibly valuable. There's no telling how long the holocron has been lost in the area, nor how well it works.

kas24_hortberr.name: Hortuth Berries
kas24_hortberr.description: Though unpalatable to most outsiders, hortuth berries are an adequate source of nourishment for a number of species native to Kashyyyk.

tar09_icebreaker.name: ICE Breaker
tar09_icebreaker.description: This device is used by criminal elements and covert operatives to slice into security computers. This particular breaker is configured for the computers on the Leviathan's brig deck. It won't work anywhere else.

g_i_upgrade002.name: Improved Energy Cell
g_i_upgrade002.description: Special: Upgrade Item, Ranged  This cell increases the energy output of certain blaster types, allowing skilled users to better deliver powerful attacks. The modifications require a workbench with adequate tools and a weapon of high quality marked as upgradeable.

g_i_pltuseitm01.name: Keycard
g_i_pltuseitm01.description: Keycards are the standard method of accessing most of the technology used in Republic space. Each card has a specific purpose and is designed to be almost tamper-proof.

tat18_dragonprl.name: Krayt Dragon Pearl
tat18_dragonprl.description: Special: Upgrade Item, Lightsaber  Taken from the gullet of a krayt dragon, this crystalline "pearl" appears to have refractory qualities that might allow it to function as a lightsaber crystal once properly adapted.

tar10_powercell.name: Magnetic Power Cell
tar10_powercell.description: This industrial strength battery is surprisingly heavy.

kas25_mandhelmet.name: Mandalorian Helmet
kas25_mandhelmet.description: This is the helmet of a fierce Mandalorian warrior, taken from a group that stalked the Shadowlands of Kashyyyk for wounded or unwary prey.

tat20aa_westmap.name: Map of the Eastern Dune Sea
tat20aa_westmap.description: By showing how to interpret ancient marker stones, this map can be used to find a safe route through the Eastern Dune Sea. Only intimate local knowledge could take the place of such a document.

tar10_mechid.name: Mechanic ID
tar10_mechid.description: This card is used by mechanics to gain access to the various levels of the Vulkar base.

g_i_upgrade006.name: Mesh Underlay
g_i_upgrade006.description: Special: Upgrade Item, Armor  Mesh underlay can have a variety of effects, depending on the nature of the armor it is applied to. The modifications require a workbench with adequate tools and armor of high quality marked as upgradeable.

tat17_vaporator.name: Moisture Vaporators
tat17_vaporator.description: These devices use a pair of vaporators to condense moisture from the air, albeit in small amounts over a long period of time. Droughts can last for centuries on some desert worlds, so this may be the only means to obtain water.

tar10_elevcar001.name: Pass Card
tar10_elevcar001.description: This is a pass card used to grant access at security terminals.

k35_itm_uthrpass.name: Passcard
k35_itm_uthrpass.description: These passcards act as keys to the academy bedrooms... this one specifically meant for the bedroom of Master Uthar.

lev09_portcellke.name: Port Cell Block Key
lev09_portcellke.description: This keycard will unlock the cells on the Leviathan's port detention block.

dan16_key001.name: Prison Key
dan16_key001.description: This key opens the holding cell in the Sandral Estate.

ptar_appjournal.name: Promised Land Apprentice Journal
ptar_appjournal.description: This journal details the search for the Promised Land carried out by Rukil's Apprentice.  Most of the entries are mundane; however, the last entry is quite interesting:  "I have uncovered evidence that others have been seeking out the fabled land, and that their treks have led them into the sewers.  I have decided that I must go there as well."

ptar_rukjournal.name: Promised Land Journal
ptar_rukjournal.description: This journal is a record of the long and difficult search to find the Promised Land. It contains many half completed maps and cryptic notes, all attempting to decipher whether the legend is true or simply a child's fable. By itself this journal does not contain enough information to solve the mystery, however it could be a valuable piece of the puzzle.

tat17_racebond.name: Race Bond
tat17_racebond.description: Issued by Motta the Hutt, these bonds are honored throughout the galaxy. Each digital certificate can usually be redeemed for around 60 credits simply by selling them to any merchant or at any store.

dan16_key.name: Rahasia's Key
dan16_key.description: This key opens the rear door to the Sandral Estate.

ptar_rakghoul001.name: Rakghoul Serum
ptar_rakghoul001.description: This vial is filled with green, bubbling liquid.

ptar_rakghoul002.name: Rakghoul Serum
ptar_rakghoul002.description: This vial is filled with green, bubbling liquid.

g_i_upgrade001.name: Scope
g_i_upgrade001.description: Special: Upgrade Item, Ranged  This scope increases the accuracy of certain blaster types, increasing the user's effectiveness with sniper attacks. The modifications require a workbench with adequate tools and a weapon of high quality marked as upgradeable.

kas25_note.name: Scrawled note
kas25_note.description: A Wookiee's dying message, it says he was attacked by off-worlders different from the Czerka. They were camouflaged, and attacked only when his group put their weapons away. He died hoping someone takes vengeance on these monsters.

tat18_wraidplate.name: Sharina's Wraid Plate
tat18_wraidplate.description: This is the incredibly dense bone skull plate of a Tatooine desert wraid.

ptar_sbpasscrd.name: Sith Base Passcard
ptar_sbpasscrd.description: A standard ID card for Sith troopers

k35_itm_sithdevc.name: Sith Device
k35_itm_sithdevc.description: This small electronic device appears to be completely self-operating. Once attached to a specific surface, it will begin deploying whatever trap is inside. Yuthura has not explained exactly what the device does... simply that it must be placed inside Master Uthar's bed in order to function.

k33_itm_sithmdln.name: Sith Medallion
k33_itm_sithmdln.description: This medallion is clearly marked with the insignia of the Sith, and otherwise consists of a shiny black onyx-like material. It is unlikely to be very valuable, but is quite distinctive.

k35_itm_sithpass.name: Sith Passcard
k35_itm_sithpass.description: This is a small identification card marking you as a student within the Sith monastery on Korriban. It will allow you to come and go as you wish.

lev40_detcard.name: Sith Passcard
lev40_detcard.description: This appears to be a high security passcard for the detention area.

lev40_spacesuit.name: Space Suit
lev40_spacesuit.description: This is a standard model space suit used to protect its wearer from the cold vacuum of space. Because of its design, anyone wearing the suit will have to unequip their weapons.

k39_itm_coldgren.name: Special Cold Grenade
k39_itm_coldgren.description: This is an incredibly large and powerful version of a standard cold grenade. When used, its blast will likely affect quite a large area.

k39_itm_firegren.name: Special Fire Grenade
k39_itm_firegren.description: This is an incredibly large and powerful version of a standard fire grenade. When used, its blast will likely affect quite a large area.

ip_pltuseitm_041.name: Spice
ip_pltuseitm_041.description: The term "spice" has come to describe a wide variety of stimulants mined on a number of worlds, but the highly coveted glitterstim found on Kessel is by far the most precious.

lev09_starcellke.name: Starboard Cell Block Key
lev09_starcellke.description: This keycard will unlock the cells on the Leviathan's starboard detention block.

strangebox.name: Strange Box
strangebox.description: The box is rather light and small, made out of an odd metal allow. It appears to have no lock and could probably be opened quite easily.

tar10_accelerato.name: Swoop Accelerator
tar10_accelerato.description: Though not overly large the prototype swoop accelerator is surprisingly heavy. Without being an expert on swoop bike construction it is difficult to imagine how this simple device could be so valuable.

tar05_synthodor.name: Synthesized Odor
tar05_synthodor.description: This appears to be a timed release device for a strange substance.  The liquid has a very pungent odor.

kas24_tachgland.name: Tach gland
kas24_tachgland.description: This gland was cut from the corpse of a tach, a small primate. It can supposedly be powdered to produce a powerful stimulant.

tar02_sithbaseke.name: tar02_sithbasekeycard
tar02_sithbaseke.description: A standard ID card for Sith troopers

ptar_shieldcodes.name: Taris Launch Codes
ptar_shieldcodes.description: This datapad contains the codes necessary to launch a ship from the planet's surface without being destroyed by the Sith autotargeting cannons.

w_token.name: Token
w_token.description: This appears to be a small token of a personal nature. Perhaps someone who knew this Selkath would recognize it.

g_i_upgrade007.name: Vibration Cell
g_i_upgrade007.description: Special: Upgrade Item, Melee  A cell like this can stabilize a melee weapon allowing it to hit and damage better, and possibly gain other effects. The modifications require a workbench with adequate tools and a weapon of high quality marked as upgradeable.

kas25_kinrathbod.name: Viper Kinrath Body
kas25_kinrathbod.description: The corpse of an exceptionally large viper kinrath, freshly killed.

g_w_poisngren01.name: Poison Grenade
g_w_poisngren01.description: Damage: Special  Secondary: Poison, 4 pts every 3 sec Duration: 30sec Area of Effect: 4m Range: Long Save: DC25 for no effect  This grenade unleashes a blast of poison gas that affects the nervous system, lingering in the air to ensure that the effect is not escaped easily.

punk_rancorgren.name: Rancor Grenade
punk_rancorgren.description: This type of grenade releases a gas that is highly toxic to rancors, but ineffective against other organisms.

g_i_progspike002.name: Computer Spike
g_i_progspike002.description: These items allow a user to slice computer programs, assaulting systems with garbage data to overwhelm security measures. They are one-use items. A high Computer Use skill reduces the number of spikes required for any given task.

g_i_progspike01.name: Computer Spike
g_i_progspike01.description: These items allow a user to slice computer programs, assaulting systems with garbage data to overwhelm security measures. They are one-use items. A high Computer Use skill reduces the number of spikes required for any given task.

g_i_parts01.name: Parts
g_i_parts01.description: This is a disposable package of universally adaptable parts, designed for characters using the Repair skill on machines. Each pack is a one-use item. A high Repair skill reduces the number of parts required for any given task.

g_i_progspike02.name:
SYSTEM LOADING...
COMPLETE
ENTER COMMAND
g_i_progspike02.description: This advanced tool improves the user's ability to slice computer programs by overwhelming system security with garbage data and standard encryption codes. It is a one-use item.

g_w_qtrstaff02.name: Massassi Battle Staff
g_w_qtrstaff02.description: The Massassi were a proud race altered by the Sith millennia ago, and subsequently exterminated along with Exar Kun. This weapon was the symbol of a proven warrior.

g_w_qtrstaff01.name: Quarterstaff
g_w_qtrstaff01.description: Usually just a smooth staff of wood or light alloys, this is a very simple weapon of ancient design.

g1_w_rptnblstr01.name: Baragwin Assault Gun
g1_w_rptnblstr01.stat_modifiers: AttackBonus +1; AttackBonus +1; AttackBonus +3; Damage; Damage; Damage; Damage
g1_w_rptnblstr01.description: Special: Upgradeable, Ranged  This light repeating blaster is an excellent example of the Baragwin aptitude for weaponry. By taking and modifying an existing repeating blaster design, the Baragwin have managed to greatly increase the damage output and added additional functionality with a variety of upgrade options.

g_w_rptnblstr004.name: Blaster Cannon
g_w_rptnblstr004.description: The blaster cannon is a favorite among captains wealthy enough to hire experienced, dangerous crews and who might need a way to take them out quick if things go bad.

g_w_rptnblstr03.name: Blaster Cannon
g_w_rptnblstr03.description: The blaster cannon is a favorite among captains wealthy enough to hire experienced, dangerous crews and who might need a way to take them out quick if things go bad.

g_w_rptnblstr01.name: Light Repeating Blaster
g_w_rptnblstr01.description: This weapon allows the user to fire more quickly than usual, increasing his chances of survival without drastically changing the amount of equipment he would normally carry.

g_w_rptnblstr02.name: Medium Repeating Blaster
g_w_rptnblstr02.description: Weapons such as this are not usually available for public purchase. They are best utilized during quick troop deployment and other situations where rapid suppressing fire is required.

g_a_mstrrobe06.name: Darth Revan's Robes
g_a_mstrrobe06.stat_modifiers: UseLimitationAlignmentGroup; Ability +4; Armor +5; Use_Limitation_Feat; Regeneration +1; UseLimitationRacial
g_a_mstrrobe06.description: Created by the mystical technology of the Star Forge, these robes focus the dark side energies of the wearer, fueling their power. The Sith Lord Darth Revan was wearing similar robes when captured by the Jedi, who viewed the garments as an abomination and destroyed them. However the Jedi Council, not being familiar with the origins of the robes, were unaware that the Star Forge would be capable of producing an item of such terrible power a second time.

g_a_mstrrobe07.name: Star Forge Robes
g_a_mstrrobe07.stat_modifiers: UseLimitationAlignmentGroup; Ability +5; Armor +5; Use_Limitation_Feat; ImprovedSavingThrowsSpecific +2; UseLimitationRacial
g_a_mstrrobe07.description: Created by the mystical technology of the Star Forge, these robes focus the inherent Force abilities of the wearer, fueling their power. Although the Star Forge itself is an artifact of the dark side, these robes were customized using an analysis of the Jedi they were created for, resulting in a powerful light side item that the Jedi can safely use against their enemies without fear of taint or corruption.

g_i_secspike01.name: Security Spike
g_i_secspike01.description: This one-use item improves the user's ability to bypass security measures, creating electronic interference in the locking mechanisms of doors and containers.

g_i_secspike02.name: Security Spike Tunneler
g_i_secspike02.description: This one-use item employs anti-encryption software and electronic interference to improve the user's ability to bypass locking mechanisms on doors and containers.

g1_w_shortsbr01.stat_modifiers: AttackBonus +3; AttackBonus +3; AttackBonus +3; AttackBonus +3; AttackBonus +3; AttackBonus +1; AttackBonus +2; AttackBonus +2; AttackBonus +3; AttackBonus +2; AttackBonus +2; AttackBonus +4; Blaster_Bolt_Deflect_Increase +7; Blaster_Bolt_Deflect_Increase +4; Damage; Damage; Damage; Damage; Damage; Damage; Damage; Damage; Damage; Damage; Damage; Damage; Damage; DamageRacialGroup; DamageRacialGroup; DamageRacialGroup; DamageRacialGroup; Massive_Criticals; OnHit +14

g_w_shortswrd02.name: Massassi Brand
g_w_shortswrd02.description: During the reign of Naga Sadow the Massassi were transformed into foot soldiers for the Sith. This was their traditional weapon, altered, as they were, to serve the dark side.

g_w_shortswrd01.name: Short Sword
g_w_shortswrd01.description: Disregarded by most modern warriors, a good short sword can still serve well in combat if the user is skilled.

g_w_shortswrd03.name: Teta's Blade
g_w_shortswrd03.description: Attributed to Empress Teta, this blade speaks of her background as a warrior and her willingness to be on the frontline of the Great Hyperspace War a thousand years ago.

g_w_sonicgren01.name: Sonic Grenade
g_w_sonicgren01.description: Damage: Sonic, 20pts Secondary: -6 Dexterity for 30 seconds Area of Effect: 4m Range: Long Save: DC15 for half damage, negates dexterity penalty  These grenades explode loudly, but the majority of their effect is delivered in disorienting frequencies the ear can barely perceive, even as it is damaged.

g_w_sonicpstl02.name: Bothan Shrieker
g_w_sonicpstl02.description: This is an improvement over the standard sonic pistol design that must seem doubly shrill to the large ears of the Bothans.

g_w_sonicpstl01.name: Sonic Pistol
g_w_sonicpstl01.description: Sometimes referred to as "squealers", these weapons deliver a high-frequency jolt to the senses that can damage and potentially disorient an opponent.

g_w_sonicrfl03.name: Arkanian Sonic Rifle
g_w_sonicrfl03.description: The Arkanians pioneered many non-lethal weapons that could disorient opponents, but most were retrofitted to be superior damage dealers as well because the initial demand for them was so low.

g_w_sonicrfl02.name: Bothan Discord Gun
g_w_sonicrfl02.description: This was conceived as a "last resort" weapon should espionage fail and a quick retreat be called for. It is effective, but the Bothans would prefer that it not be needed.

g_w_sonicrfl01.name: Sonic Rifle
g_w_sonicrfl01.description: More powerful than the pistol, the sonic rifle fires a blast of sound that causes a great deal of sensory overload in addition to damage, disorienting the victim.

g_i_medeqpmnt08.name: Squad Recovery Stim
g_i_medeqpmnt08.description: Each squad recovery stim includes a number of fittings to be placed on every member of the group (automatically done at purchase). When activated, a stim shot is triggered that heals everyone for 10 vitality points. This unit also includes electro-stim fittings that spur the auto-repair functions of droid group members, effectively repairing them for 10 vitality points as well.

g_i_belt007.name: Advanced Stealth Unit
g_i_belt007.description: Costly to produce, this unit refines the Stealth Mode field to better camouflage the user. Opponents must make an Awareness check versus user Stealth skill +4 or remain unaware of them. The user must have paid points into the Stealth skill to use Stealth Mode. Combat disrupts the field, but mundane tasks do not.

g1_i_belt001.name: Baragwin Stealth Unit
g1_i_belt001.description: Similar in concept to the Baragwin Shadow Armor, the Baragwin Stealth Unit is a quantum leap in advancement over standard stealth units. It provides much greater camouflage, as well as enhancing the mobility and situational awareness of the wearer to potential threats.

g_i_belt008.name: Eriadu Stealth Unit
g_i_belt008.description: This sophisticated Eriadu Stealth Mode unit expertly camouflages the user. Opponents must make an Awareness check versus user Stealth skill +6 or remain unaware of them. The user must have paid points into the Stealth skill to gain the use of Stealth Mode. Combat disrupts the field, but mundane tasks do not.

geno_stealth.name: GenoHaradan Stealth Unit
geno_stealth.description: The assassins of the GenoHaradan work in absolute secrecy, thanks to items such as this highly advanced stealth unit.

g_i_belt006.name: Sound Dampening Stealth Unit
g_i_belt006.description: This Republic unit improves on the basic Stealth Mode field by dampening all sound that the user might make. Opponents must make an Awareness check versus user Stealth skill +2 or remain unaware of them. The user must have paid points into the Stealth skill to gain the use of Stealth Mode. Combat disrupts the field, but mundane tasks do not.

g_i_belt010.name: Stealth Field Generator
g_i_belt010.description: This device enables Stealth Mode, a camouflage field that hides the user. Opponents must make an Awareness check versus the Stealth skill of the user or remain unaware of them. The user must have paid points into the Stealth skill to use Stealth Mode. Combat disrupts the field, but mundane tasks do not.

g_w_stunbaton03.name: Bothan Chuka
g_w_stunbaton03.description: A very effective device used by Bothan elite. Some systems consider simple possession of one as grounds for execution as a spy. High-density discharge cells make this item unwieldy and unusable in the off-hand.

g_w_stunbaton02.name: Bothan Stun Stick
g_w_stunbaton02.description: A useful tool for espionage, this weapon is more effective than the standard stun baton, but is still available on most worlds. High-density discharge cells make this item unwieldy and unusable in the off-hand.

g_w_stunbaton005.name: Elder Rakatan Battle Wand
g_w_stunbaton005.stat_modifiers: AttackBonus +4; Damage; Damage; Damage; Enhancement +2; OnHit +14; OnHit +18
g_w_stunbaton005.description: Special: Upgradeable, Melee  Weighted to fit a Rakatan grip, this item is most like a stun baton. It seems more adaptable than one of Republic issue, though similar high-density cells make it unwieldy and unusable with weapons in the off-hand.

g_w_stunbaton04.name: Rakatan Battle Wand

g_w_stunbaton07.name: Rakatan Battle Wand
g_w_stunbaton07.description: Special: Upgradeable, Melee  Weighted to fit a Rakatan grip, this item is most like a stun baton. It seems more adaptable than one of Republic issue, though similar high-density cells make it unwieldy and unusable with weapons in the off-hand.

g_w_stunbaton01.name: Stun Baton
g_w_stunbaton01.description: A common weapon, stun batons do minimal damage but can incapacitate a target. The high-density cells needed for repeated discharge are unwieldy, making it unusable in the off-hand.

ptar_shockstick.name: Vulkar Shock Stick
ptar_shockstick.description: A favorite weapon of the Vulkars, this modified stun baton is designed more for the purpose of inflicting pain than actually incapacitating an opponent. The high-density cells needed for repeated discharge are unwieldy, making it unusable in the off-hand.

flash_gren.name: Concussion Grenade
flash_gren.description: Damage: None Secondary: Stun for 9sec Area of Effect: 4m Range: Long Save: DC15 for no effect  This type of grenade explodes in a concussive wave of force that disrupts the senses of both organic and inorganic targets in the area of effect.

g_w_stungren01.name: Concussion Grenade
g_w_stungren01.description: Damage: None Secondary: Stun for 9sec Area of Effect: 4m Range: Long Save: DC15 for no effect  This type of grenade explodes in a concussive wave of force that disrupts the senses of both organic and inorganic targets in the area of effect.

g_w_thermldet002.name: Thermal Detonator
g_w_thermldet002.description: Damage: Energy, 60pts Secondary: Knockdown Area of Effect: 4m Range: Long Save: DC15 for half damage  This Republic device contains a baradium compound that produces a small fusion energy explosion of great force. Civilian possession of these items is outlawed almost everywhere.

g_w_thermldet01.name: Thermal Detonator
g_w_thermldet01.description: Damage: Energy, 60pts Secondary: Knockdown Area of Effect: 4m Range: Long Save: DC15 for half damage  This Republic device contains a baradium compound that produces a small fusion energy explosion of great force. Civilian possession of these items is outlawed almost everywhere.

g_i_torch01.name: Torch
g_i_torch01.description: A wooden stake wrapped in oil-soaked rags that can be ignited to provide a light source.

g_i_trapkit002.name: Average Flash Mine
g_i_trapkit002.description: Damage: None Secondary: Stun for 9sec Area of Effect: 3.3m radius Save : DC20 to negate stun  This variant of the stun mine is an improvement on the basic model. Larger power cells increase its effectiveness a considerable amount.

g_i_trapkit005.name: Average Frag Mine
g_i_trapkit005.description: Damage: Piercing, 30pts  Area of Effect: 3.3m radius  Save : DC20 for half damage  Like all frag mines, this item sends a blast of shrapnel through any nearby enemies. This variant is much more powerful than the basic model.

g_i_trapkit011.name: Average Gas Mine
g_i_trapkit011.description: Damage: Special  Secondary: Poison, 4 pts every 3 sec  Duration: 30sec  Area of Effect: 3.3m radius  Save: DC20 for no effect  This item emits a far more toxic cloud of gas than the basic model mine of this type.

g_i_trapkit008.name: Average Plasma Mine
g_i_trapkit008.description: Damage: Heat, 42pts  Area of Effect: 3.3m radius  Save: DC20 for half damage  An extremely volatile mixture of incendiary chemicals makes this plasma mine much more powerful than the basic model.

g_i_trapkit003.name: Deadly Flash Mine
g_i_trapkit003.description: Damage: None  Secondary: Stun for 9sec  Area of Effect: 3.3m radius  Save : DC25 to negate stun  The most powerful stun mine available, this item can quickly disable anyone unfortunate enough to activate it.

g_i_trapkit006.name: Deadly Frag Mine
g_i_trapkit006.description: Damage: Piercing, 54pts  Area of Effect: 3.3m radius  Save : DC25 for half damage  The most powerful fragmentation mine available, this item can make short work of entire battle groups.

g_i_trapkit012.name: Deadly Gas Mine
g_i_trapkit012.description: Damage: Special  Secondary: Poison, 5 pts every 3 secs  Duration: 30sec  Area of Effect: 3.3m radius  Save: DC30 for no effect  The most toxic poison mine available, this item can quickly reduce the effectiveness of entire enemy groups.

g_i_trapkit009.name: Deadly Plasma Mine
g_i_trapkit009.description: Damage: Heat, 72pts  Area of Effect: 3.3m radius  Save: DC25 for half damage  The most damaging plasma mine available, this item throws intense heat over a wide radius.

g_i_trapkit01.name: Flash Mine
g_i_trapkit01.description: Flash mines explode in a blast of light and sound that can temporarily blind or deafen, as well as inflict damage. The user must have adequate skill to place them effectively.

g_i_trapkit02.name: Frag Mine
g_i_trapkit02.description: When triggered, frag mines spread shrapnel across a wide blast range, inflicting painful physical damage. The user must have adequate skill to place them effectively.

g_i_trapkit04.name: Gas Mine
g_i_trapkit04.description: When triggered, gas mines emit a noxious cloud of poisonous neurotoxins, affecting everyone nearby. The user must have adequate skill to place them effectively.

g_i_trapkit03.name: Laser Mine
g_i_trapkit03.description: When triggered, laser mines launch a small emitter that inflicts energy damage on a wide area. The user must have adequate skill to place them effectively.

g_i_trapkit001.name: Minor Flash Mine
g_i_trapkit001.description: Damage: None  Secondary: Stun for 9sec  Area of Effect: 3.3m radius  Save : DC15 to negate stun  Carefully set flash mines can stun any enemies unfortunate enough to step on them. This is the basic model.

dan_mine_prop.name: Minor Frag Mine
dan_mine_prop.description: Damage: Piercing, 18pts  Area of Effect: 3.3m radius  Save : DC15 for half damage  Frag mines send blasts of shrapnel through any nearby enemies. This is the basic model.

g_i_trapkit004.name: Minor Frag Mine
g_i_trapkit004.description: Damage: Piercing, 18pts  Area of Effect: 3.3m radius  Save : DC15 for half damage  Frag mines send blasts of shrapnel through any nearby enemies. This is the basic model.

g_i_trapkit010.name: Minor Gas Mine
g_i_trapkit010.description: Damage: Special  Secondary: Poison, 3 pts every 3 sec  Duration: 30sec  Area of Effect: 3.3m radius  Save: DC15 for no effect  When stepped on, gas mines saturate the immediate area with poisonous gas. This is the basic model.

g_i_trapkit007.name: Minor Plasma Mine
g_i_trapkit007.description: Damage: Heat, 24pts  Area of Effect: 3.3m radius  Save: DC15 for half damage  When stepped on, plasma mines emit a short burst of intense heat, searing all enemies nearby. This is the basic model.

g_i_recordrod01.name: Recording Rod
g_i_recordrod01.description: These rods are used to record audio logs. They are popular among researchers and politicians.

g_w_vbroshort03.name: Echani Vibroblade
g_w_vbroshort03.description: These blades are typically used in the off hand. In addition to a cortosis weave that deflects lightsaber sparring damage, some Echani vibroblades are supercooled to keep them in alignment, giving them an icy sting.

g_w_vbroshort02.name: Krath Blood Blade
g_w_vbroshort02.description: Twisted by the dark side, this Krath weapon is as deadly as a modern vibroblade. It was meant for assassination, and a cortosis weave that prevents lightsaber sparring damage ensured that even Jedi must respect it.

g_w_vbroshort08.name: Mission's Vibroblade
g_w_vbroshort08.description: Special: Upgradeable, Melee  Working with few resources, Mission Vao turned this basic vibroblade into an exceptional weapon almost as adaptable as she is.

g_w_vbroshort09.name: Prototype Vibroblade
g_w_vbroshort09.stat_modifiers: AttackBonus +1; AttackBonus +2; Damage; Damage; Damage; Damage
g_w_vbroshort09.description: Special: Upgradeable, Melee  This is a very adaptable model of vibroblade, made for the user on a budget that will be purchasing upgrades as resources or finances become available.

g_w_vbroshort04.name: Sanasiki's Blade
g_w_vbroshort04.description: Special: Upgradeable, Melee  Sanasiki used this weapon to kill Nelinik, a Zabrak who assassinated the Echani High Protector with battle droids. Cortosis protects the blade against lightsaber sparring damage while energy cells disrupt droid opponents.

g_w_vbroshort05.name: Sanasiki's Blade
g_w_vbroshort05.description: Special: Upgradeable, Melee  Sanasiki used this weapon to kill Nelinik, a Zabrak who assassinated the Echani High Protector with battle droids. Cortosis protects the blade against lightsaber sparring damage while energy cells disrupt droid opponents.

g_w_vbroshort07.description: Special: Upgradeable, Melee  Sanasiki used this weapon to kill Nelinik, a Zabrak who assassinated the Echani High Protector with battle droids. Cortosis protects the blade against lightsaber sparring damage while energy cells disrupt droid opponents.

g_w_vbroshort002.name: Vibroblade
g_w_vbroshort002.description: Small size makes this a good off hand weapon. Echani vibroblades use a rare cortosis weave to prevent lightsaber sparring damage, allowing traditional swordplay to continue in the time of Jedi and Sith.

g_w_vbrdblswd03.name: Echani Double-Brand
g_w_vbrdblswd03.description: Excess energy from the generator in this vibrosword is conducted directly through the blades. Also possessing a rare lightsaber-deflecting cortosis weave, this weapon is a deadly Echani masterpiece.

g_w_vbrdblswd02.name: Sith War Sword
g_w_vbrdblswd02.description: Though most favor lightsabers, some Sith prefer the more visceral feel of metal cutting flesh. These blades are usually impregnated with rare cortosis to protect against lightsaber sparring damage.

g_w_vbrdblswd01.name: Vibro Double-Blade
g_w_vbrdblswd01.description: Ultrasonic vibrations make this double-bladed sword exceptionally deadly. A rare Echani cortosis weave protects it against lightsaber sparring damage, ensuring effectiveness even against Jedi and Sith. The double-bladed sword is capable of inflicting more damage - but is also less precise - than the single-bladed variant.

g_w_vbrdblswd04.stat_modifiers: AttackBonus +1; Damage; DamageRacialGroup; DamageRacialGroup; Enhancement +2; Keen; OnHit +10
g_w_vbrdblswd04.description: Special: Upgradeable, Melee  Yusanis was the most famous of Echani warriors, fighting against oppression and villainy until encountering Darth Revan. Discovering that Revan had killed an Echani senator, Yusanis attempted to tell authorities but fell to the powers of the Sith Lord despite his own impressive abilities and the cortosis weave inherent in all Echani vibroblades.

g_w_vbroswrd05.name: Bacca's Ceremonial Blade
g_w_vbroswrd05.description: Special: Upgradeable, Melee  The great Bacca was hunting the Shadowlands ages ago when an alien ship crashed through the forest. He saw that first contact as a warning of the destruction outsiders could bring. Made from the debris, this sword is a reminder for his people that trust must be given cautiously, and only to those who have earned it.

g1_w_vbroswrd01.stat_modifiers: AttackBonus +2; AttackBonus +1; AttackBonus +1; AttackBonus +1; Damage; Damage; Damage; Keen
g1_w_vbroswrd01.description: Special: Upgradeable, Melee  This advanced vibrosword is a miracle of miniaturization technology. Not only does it deliver increased functionality over a normal vibrosword, it also has capacitors which discharge upon contact with a target. Extra space within the blade can be utilized by a variety of common upgrade modules.

g_w_vbroswrd04.name: Echani Foil
g_w_vbroswrd04.description: These swords were crafted to honor Raskta Fenni, the best Echani duelist of her time. Many were sold, but imperfections in the difficult lightsaber-deflecting cortosis weave caused few to survive.

geno_blade.name: GenoHaradan Poison Blade
geno_blade.description: Forged by the Genoharadan for the exclusive use of their agents, this deadly assassin's blade contains a cannister that emits small doses of poison with each successful hit on an opponent.

g_w_vbroswrd02.name: Krath Dire Sword
g_w_vbroswrd02.description: This was a weapon of distinction in the time of the Krath. Protected against lightsaber sparring damage, Sith would grant these cortosis-laced blades to only the most loyal underlings.

g_w_vbroswrd03.name: Sith Tremor Sword
g_w_vbroswrd03.description: Traced to the Bladeborn, a Sith offshoot dedicated to sword mastery, these cortosis-laced weapons were given to "masterblades" who survived no less than ten lightsaber-wielding warriors in combat.

g_w_vbroswrd002.name: Vibrosword
g_w_vbroswrd002.description: Ultrasonic generators power this Echani-developed weapon design. A rare cortosis weave that protects against sparring damage ensures that traditional swordplay will endure in the time of lightsabers.

k37_itm_freednf2.name: Vibrosword
k37_itm_freednf2.description: Like most vibro blades, this weapon lets off a dim humming sound once activated. Its length shimmers with a deep blue-colored force field, and its hilt is the black of charcoal. A single insignia upon the hilt shows that of a red, baleful eye.

g_w_warblade001.name: Wookiee Warblade
g_w_warblade001.description: Though initially they might seem cumbersome, Wookiee Warblades are actually a very efficient design. Kept in continual motion, they can cut a swath through almost anything.
